7a8bb721.title: Solution Architect
7a8bb721.description:
### Role Overview

Syndigo is looking for a **Solution Architect** to own end-to-end solution and functional architecture for enterprise **PXM, PIM, and MDM** implementations, ensuring strong alignment between business strategy, data strategy, and technical execution.

This role is accountable for leading discovery, defining target-state architecture, and producing clear, scalable, governed functional designs across systems. The Solution Architect works with customers, Program Managers, Implementation Leads, Product, Engineering, and Partners to translate requirements into executable solutions.

The Solution Architect reduces delivery risk and prevents rework by acting as the **design authority** and **data governance champion** across Syndigo's delivery programmes. As agentic commerce reshapes how product data is consumed, this role also owns whether a customers data foundation is genuinely ready for AI.

### Key Duties & Responsibilities

#### Functional Solution Design

* Lead functional discovery to understand business processes, data requirements, and target-state objectives
* Define and document data models, hierarchies, taxonomies, attributes, workflows, and business rules across PXM, PIM, and MDM
* Translate business requirements into scalable, governed functional designs aligned to platform capability
* Produce a clear Functional Specification Document at the close of each solution phase

#### Integration & Data Strategy

* Define integration approach, system interaction models, and data ownership boundaries
* Align data migration strategy, validation approach, and cutover planning with delivery teams
* Ensure functional alignment across upstream systems such as ERP and PLM and downstream channels such as commerce, marketplaces, and syndication
* Set data quality thresholds and governance rules that the delivered solution must sustain

#### Design for AI & Agentic Commerce

* Assess whether a customers taxonomy, attribution, and data quality are sufficient for AI enrichment and agentic consumption
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints into target-state workflows so automation stays governed
* Define where AI agents may act unattended and where human approval remains mandatory
* Specify the data quality and completeness thresholds that make AI output trustworthy

#### Cross-Functional & Multi-Team Collaboration

* Partner closely with Implementation Leads, Program Managers, Product, Engineering, and partner teams
* Facilitate customer and partner workshops, design reviews, and solution walkthroughs
* Provide continuous design guidance during implementation to prevent scope creep and rework

#### Design Governance & Quality

* Act as design authority to ensure functional consistency and architectural integrity against Syndigo best practice and product guidelines
* Ensure adherence to data governance standards, best practice, and Center of Excellence guidelines
* Review solution changes and assess downstream impact across systems before approval

#### Working with AI

The Solution Architect carries the deepest AI responsibility in the delivery organisation. The role decides whether a customers data foundation can support AI and agentic commerce, and designs the governance that keeps automation safe.

* Lead data readiness assessment for AI, covering taxonomy structure, attribute coverage, completeness, and data quality
* Design target-state architecture that supports AI-driven enrichment, content generation, and agentic retrieval
* Define human-in-the-loop control points, approval thresholds, and audit requirements within designed workflows
* Use approved AI tooling to accelerate discovery synthesis, data profiling, mapping proposals, and design documentation
* Validate every AI-assisted design artefact personally, since design errors propagate further than build errors
* Advise customers honestly on where AI will and will not deliver value against their current data maturity

### Required Skills & Abilities

* Strong analytical and functional solution design capability for enterprise data platforms
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable, governed functional designs
* Strong understanding of PXM, PIM, MDM, or comparable data platforms and their integration patterns
* Deep grounding in data governance, data quality, taxonomy, and master data principles
* Excellent workshop facilitation and stakeholder communication skills
* Ability to reduce ambiguity early and prevent downstream delivery risk
* Clear communication with both technical and business audiences, including executive stakeholders

### Education & Experience

* Bachelors degree required. Masters degree or equivalent advanced credential preferred
* **10+ years** in solution architecture, business analysis, or enterprise data platforms
* Strong experience with PXM, PIM, MDM, or comparable data-centric platforms
* Data management certification such as CDMP or DAMA DMBOK alignment is an advantage

### Technical Skill Set

* Enterprise PXM, PIM, MDM, or comparable data platforms
* APIs, integrations, REST services, and JSON-based configuration
* SQL and reporting for data analysis, profiling, and validation
* Python and Postman for data inspection, API validation, and analysis
* Data modelling notation, taxonomy design, and hierarchy management
* GS1 standards, GDSN, and retailer or marketplace content requirements
* Data quality measurement and governance frameworks

### This is a hybrid position

This is a hybrid position that requires 3 days per week in office at our Bangalore location

### Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

### Gdpr/ccpa

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

6e4e0c01.description:

**Experience:** 10-15 Years

Role Overview

This role will be responsible for partnering with client stakeholders at the board and executive levels to translate complex business challenges into production-ready autonomous agentic architectures. You will own the technical relationship during the discovery phase, blueprint the core reference architectures, and guide our internal engineering pods through successful implementation.

Key Responsibilities

* **Solution Architecture & Technical Blueprinting:** Design and document standardized, enterprise-grade Reference Architectures for multi-agent orchestration and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using the Claude Code or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Blueprint end-to-end Agentic Workflows, mapping out how multi-turn reasoning, persistent memory, and state management will behave in live environments. Build reusable architecture scaffolds and integration patterns that allow developers to connect agents to core enterprise systems (eg, Splunk, Elastic, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and custom telemetry stacks). Transition seamlessly from abstract whiteboard designs to concrete implementation by writing core foundational code, configuration scripts, or orchestration loops alongside the engineering team. Act as the technical bridge between Softility s delivery teams and Google Cloud s partner engineering group to unblock platform-level execution barriers.
* **Tactical Pre-Sales & Consultative Engagement:** Act as the primary technical authority during high-touch, pre-sales discovery workshops to discover, define, and scope client use cases. Conduct highly technical product demonstrations and deliver deep-dive sessions to client engineering teams, effectively neutralizing competitive technologies (eg, OpenAI Assistants, AWS Bedrock).
* **Model Optimization & Workload Selection:** Evaluate enterprise tasks to select the optimal model configuration, balancing computational efficiency and accuracy. Define token budget management strategies and performance caching layers to ensure client systems scale effectively. Design benchmarking metrics to continually evaluate agent precision, grounding scores, and execution latency.
* **Security, Compliance & Semantic Governance:** Oversee absolute security compliance for all agent deployments, ensuring architectures adhere to Zero-Trust standards and strict data residency mandates. Design and implement Semantic Governance Layers to enforce safety guidelines, prevent hallucinations, and automate PII masking before data reaches foundational model layers.

Required Technical & Professional Skills

* **Cloud Expertise (Preferably GCP):** Deep architectural knowledge of Google Cloud Vertex AI (Agent Platform), BigQuery, VPC Service Controls, and IAM security frameworks.
* **Agentic Frameworks & AI Tooling:** Proven experience building production-level autonomous systems utilizing the Gemini ADK, LangChain, or comparable agentic libraries.
* **Backend Mastery:** Exceptional proficiency in Python or Node.js, combined with deep familiarity with API design, enterprise webhooks, and asynchronous message queues.
* **Modern Integration Standards:** Direct experience working with enterprise application API architectures (REST, gRPC) for platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, or large-scale Observability stacks.
* **System Observability:** Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel), logging fabrics, and monitoring frameworks to track agent behavior in production environments.
* **DevOps & CI/CD:** Strong experience in modern DevOps methodologies, including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and automated CI/CD pipeline structures.

Preferred Certifications (Bonus)

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

9ce5b551.description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.

This is a process-driven, customer-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL-aligned support environment.

You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).

**Key Responsibilities**

You will deliver day-to-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.

Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.

As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 & L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.

You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.

Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.

You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.

Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.

You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance.

 **Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* 2-3 years of overall Experience working in an application support or service desk role
* Hands on experience of implementation and supporting the Projects Module in Cloud
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift-based model and collaborate across global teams

**Desirable Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems

**Key Behaviours & Attributes**

* Customer-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

9cfae76c.title: Prisma Cloud Customer Success Engineer
9cfae76c.description:
**Experience**
- 3 to 8 years

**Location**
- Remote

**Shift**
- EMEA

**Job Description**

A
**Prisma Cloud Customer Success Engineer (CSE)**
is a customer-facing technical role focused on helping customers
**deploy, adopt, optimize, and get business value.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Act as the
  **technical point of contact**
  for customers using Prisma Cloud.
* Help customers onboard and configure Prisma Cloud across
  **AWS, Azure, and GCP**
  .
* Understand customer cloud-security requirements and translate them into Prisma Cloud solutions.
* Guide customers through:
* CSPM
* CNAPP
* CIEM
* CWPP / workload protection
* Container and Kubernetes security
* Vulnerability management
* Compliance monitoring
* Troubleshoot Prisma Cloud configuration, integration, policy, and deployment issues.
* Analyze customer security findings and recommend
  **remediation strategies**
  .
* Help customers integrate Prisma Cloud with:
* SIEM/SOAR
* Ticketing systems
* CI/CD pipelines
* Kubernetes
* Cloud-native security services
* Conduct technical enablement sessions, workshops, demos, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
* Create implementation guides, architecture diagrams, troubleshooting documentation, and best-practice recommendations.
* Monitor customer adoption and identify opportunities to improve their use of Prisma Cloud.
* Work closely with
  **Support, Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering**
  teams.
* Handle escalations and drive technical issues through to resolution.
* Help customers establish cloud-security
  **best practices, governance, and automation**
  .

What Makes the CSE Role Different?

A normal
**Prisma Cloud Engineer**
may primarily operate the platform internally.

A
**Customer Success Engineer**
is much more
**customer-facing**
:

**Customer requirement → Technical design → Prisma Cloud implementation → Enablement → Adoption → Troubleshooting → Optimization**

So communication and consulting skills are almost as important as Prisma Cloud technical knowledge.

**Prisma Cloud**

* Prisma Cloud CSPM
* Prisma Cloud Compute
* CNAPP
* CIEM
* CWPP
* Kubernetes/container security
* Cloud compliance
* Vulnerability management
* Policy configuration and tuning

**Cloud**

* AWS / Azure / GCP
* IAM
* Networking
* Compute
* Storage
* Kubernetes services such as EKS, AKS, and GKE

**DevSecOps**

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Terraform
* Git
* CI/CD
* Infrastructure as Code
* API integrations

**Customer-facing**

* Technical presentations
* Requirements gathering
* Troubleshooting
* Stakeholder management
* Architecture discussions
* Documentation
* Training and enablement

You would likely be expected to:

* Independently manage technically complex customers.
* Lead Prisma Cloud onboarding and adoption.
* Design multi-cloud security architectures.
* Troubleshoot difficult production issues.
* Explain technical findings to both engineers and management.
* Drive remediation and security improvements.
* Mentor other CSEs/engineers.
* Work with product/engineering on difficult customer escalations.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.

The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. da699e63.title: Technical Delivery Manager
da699e63.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions. Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future.
  
  
What We Do
  
  
Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data—such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions—into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity, and beyond.
  
  
How We Do It
  
  
From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely advances smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics, and time-of-use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAI™ platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.
  
  
For more information, please visit:
  
  

* Website: www.bidgely.com
* Blog: bidgely.com/blog

**About The Role**
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to head a cross-functional team in implementing and configuring our product solutions for enterprise-level clients. This role demands extensive technical leadership, people management, and project ownership skills, ensuring thorough quality checks and leading innovative approaches (e.g., GenAI, automation) to streamline delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with internal engineering, R&D, QA, and support teams, receiving high-level, outcome-based requirements from our Technical Program Managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Strategic Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers and project leads, ensuring a high standard of performance, engagement, and professional growth.
* Develop and optimize team structures, resource planning, and talent development strategies to scale delivery capabilities.
* Foster a culture that values ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

Senior-Level Project Delivery
  
  

* Translate complex, outcome-driven requirements from Technical Program Managers into comprehensive project roadmaps and execution plans.
* Oversee multiple, concurrent implementation projects—coordinating internal teams to ensure timely, budget-conscious, and high-quality releases.
* Communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively with senior stakeholders and leadership.

Quality Assurance & Release Management
  
  

* Establish and uphold rigorous quality controls, encompassing functionality, data integrity, performance, and user acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA resources (matrixed or dedicated) to align on testing strategies, automation frameworks, and release protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in release readiness processes and performance metrics.

Technical Innovation & Problem-Solving
  
  

* Provide deep-dive technical guidance, from code-level debugging to data-level analysis, empowering the team to solve complex challenges.
* Collaborate with R&D to integrate new product features seamlessly, ensuring reliable configurations for enterprise-scale use cases.
* Champion the introduction and application of cutting-edge tools—including GenAI—to automate, optimize, and simplify implementation workflows.

Process Optimization & Automation
  
  

* Identify and implement strategic improvements to reduce manual effort, boost delivery speed, and maintain consistent quality across projects.
* Promote documentation, best practices, and standardized procedures to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Leverage metrics, analytics, and user feedback to iterate on processes and evolve best-in-class delivery methodologies.

**Requirements**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in software delivery, implementation, or technical program/project management, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale, cross-functional projects in fast-paced or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS) is a plus.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Demonstrated proficiency in software configuration, integration APIs, data pipelines, debugging, and system performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience tackling complex technical issues at both application and data levels.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI).

Leadership & Communication
  
  

* Strong background in leading and mentoring high-performing technical teams, including architects, senior developers, and QA leads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of interfacing with executive-level audiences.
* Adept at guiding cross-functional groups toward common goals and managing change in a dynamic environment.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Experience in the energy or utilities sector is beneficial, but not required.
* Ability to adapt rapidly to evolving industry trends and new technologies.

Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  
Bidgely is an equal-opportunity employer. We are serious about and embrace diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills to build a better future and a better workforce.

**Cloud Delivery Manager Cloud Migrations (AWS)**  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Cloud Delivery Manager to lead complex enterprise migration and modernization programmes to AWS. The role combines accountable delivery leadership with sufficient technical depth to challenge solution decisions, govern risks, and earn client trust through the full migration lifecycle.  
Key responsibilities  
 Own end-to-end programme delivery across discovery, assessment, landing-zone readiness, wave planning, migration execution, cutover, warranty, and transition to operations. Overall responsible for Project/People/Account Management.  
 Lead multiple cross-functional and distributed teams; manage scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive governance. Awareness of Data Privacy, Security, IP & Responsible AI activities  
¢ Review solution architectures and migration strategies; validate application dependency maps, migration waves, security, resilience, performance, operability, and cost assumptions.  
¢ Chair migration readiness and technical governance forums such as ARB, WAR etc.; lead Go/No-Go decisions, coordinate cutover, rollback, business validation, warranty, and service acceptance.  
¢ Leverage and promote adoption of AI in project SDLC  
¢ AI Tool Proficiency- GPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini.   
¢ AI-Augmented Delivery Thinking.  
¢ AI Ethics, Risk & Governance.  
¢ Partner with client business, security, infrastructure, application, data, and operations leaders to translate technical constraints into clear business impacts and decisions.

¢ Drive adoption of cloud governance and FinOps practices, including policy, tagging, cost allocation, budget controls, rightsizing, and optimization backlogs.

Required qualifications and skills

¢ **Engineering fluency:** Understanding of DevOps/CI-CD, IaC (Terraform, Bicep or ARM), Kubernetes, APIs.

Preferred qualifications and skills

eeb9b642.title: Program Manager
eeb9b642.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

35b5592f.title: Technical Program Manager - Underwriting
35b5592f.description:

Ensure underwriting technology is delivered predictably and run reliably. The TPM plans and orchestrates multi-team, multi-vendor programs for transformation, and owns the delivery and operational rhythmfor BAU: releases, production support, SLAs, risks and dependencies.

Key responsibilities

Business-as-usual (BAU)

* Own the release calendarfor underwriting systems:release planning, changeadvisory (CAB), go / no-go, deployment and post-release verification.
* Govern production support: incident, problemand change management for underwriting applications; drive RCA and permanent fixes.
* Track and enforce internal and vendor SLAs for L2 / L3 support and enhancement requests.
* Coordinate regulatory and audit-driven technical changes (VAPT closures, DR drills, accessreviews, IRDAI cybersecurity requirements).
* Maintain capacity planning across BAU vs. transformation and flag over-commitment early.

Transformation programs

* Plan and run largeprograms such as rules enginemigration, core platformintegration, API / microservices modernisation, cloud moves and AI model deployment.
* Build integrated plans across teamsand vendors: milestones, critical path, dependencies, environments and cutover.
* Run the program cadence: sprint reviews, PI / quarterly planning, steering committees and status reporting.
* Maintain RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs and drive mitigations to closure.
* Partner with Architecture on technical design decisions, non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security) and technical debt.
* Manage program budgets, vendor statements of work, milestones and invoicing linked to deliverables.
* Plan and execute data migration, parallel runs, cutover and hypercare.

Delivery excellence

* Introduce delivery metrics (DORA-style) and continuously improve engineering flow.
* Standardise delivery artefacts and make program health visible through dashboards.

Skills required

**Good to have**

* 5+ years in technical program/ project management delivering software in an enterprise environment
* Strong grasp of SDLC, Agile(Scrum / Kanban) and hybrid delivery for regulated environments
* Technical fluency: APIs, integrations, microservices, databases, cloud basics; able to engage with architects and engineers
* Release, changeand incident management experience (ITIL practices)
* Proven management of multiple vendors / system integrators, SOWs and SLAs
* Risk and dependency management across multiple teams
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent; strong reporting and dashboarding
* Budget tracking and program financials
* Clear writtenand verbal communication, including steering-committee reporting
* BFSI experience (insurance, banking or NBFC)
* Insurance / underwriting domainexposure (proposal lifecycle, policy issuance)
* Experience withcore insurance platforms (e.g., TCS BaNCS or similar)
* Delivery of AI / ML or data platform programs (model deployment, MLOps)
* DevOps andCI/CD exposure (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps), automated testing
* Cloud migration experience (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Awareness of IRDAI Information and Cyber Security guidelines and DPDP Act
* Certifications: PMP/ PgMP, SAFeRTE / SPC,CSM, ITIL v4
* Prior hands-on engineering background (developer / QA / architect)

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT or related field.

Behavioural competencies

460cd46c.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
460cd46c.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences:
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
**Work/Life Balance**
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Inclusive Team Culture**
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
**Mentorship And Career Growth**
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADSIPL - Maharashtra

b1e8d426.title: Intermediate Technical Program Manager
b1e8d426.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. In your first year, you’ll be expected to independently run a portfolio of programs from scoping through delivery and retrospectives, and to improve how R&D programs operate by contributing to and evolving Technical Program Management best practices.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.
* Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.
* Own end-to-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.
* Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.
* Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.
* Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.
* Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.
* Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.
* Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.
* Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.
* Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.
* Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.

**About The Team**
You’ll join the R&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross-functional team that leads high-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and partners in other functions to improve how programs are planned, executed, and communicated, helping evolve shared practices, templates, and tooling for program governance across R&D.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

fc3886a8.title: Technology Program Manager
fc3886a8.description:
**Job Description**
**Program Manager, Product Development**
**Role Summary**
Drives end-to-end program execution across the Enterprise Lease Abstraction Platform's product development initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring delivery stays aligned with the platform roadmap set by the Platform Manager. Combines strong program execution skills with working business analysis capability, able to define scope directly and step into detailing of scope activities when dedicated BA support isn't available or bandwidth is constrained. Operates with an ownership mindset — focused on getting the initiative delivered, not on strict role boundaries.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand business objectives and independently define/scope the work required to deliver an initiative, including boundaries, assumptions, and out-of-scope items
* Translate the platform strategic roadmap into an executable program plan with milestones and sequencing
* Coordinate delivery across engineering, BA, architecture, and QA teams to keep initiatives on track
* Identify, track, and manage cross-team dependencies and critical-path risks
* Run program governance: status reporting, steering committee updates, RAID logs
* Manage scope, schedule, and resourcing trade-offs; escalate conflicts to the Platform Manager
* Step into a details role when needed — gathering requirements, documenting processes, running requirements workshops — to keep an initiative moving when dedicated BA capacity isn't available
* Own release planning and coordinate go-live readiness across teams
* Facilitate sprint/PI-level ceremonies (planning, reviews, retros) where relevant
* Manage vendor or third-party delivery partners contributing to the program
* Maintain a single source of truth for program status, risks, and decisions
* Support post-implementation reviews and capture lessons learned
* Pick up gaps that fall between roles rather than waiting for them to be formally assigned — if something is blocking delivery and no one else owns it, take it on or actively find who should

**Key Skills / Attributes**

* Strong scoping discipline — able to size work without waiting on a formal requirements document
* Working BA capability: requirements elicitation, process mapping, user story writing
* Comfortable operating as both “program lead” and “hands-on analyst” depending on what the initiative needs
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination
* Ownership attitude: treats “that's not my job” as unacceptable when delivery is at stake — proactively fills gaps, flags issues even outside direct responsibility, and drives outcomes rather than deflecting to process or role definitions

*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
As a Salesforce Project Manager (Individual contributor), you will lead & own the end-to-end delivery of global, outcomes-based Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies and modern, AI-enabled delivery practices. You will be accountable for delivery excellence, financial performance, governance, and stakeholder alignment, operating with a strong business-owner & customer-first mindset. This role requires strategic thinking, executive presence, and hands-on delivery leadership to manage complex Salesforce programs, protect project margins, and scale delivery impact across the organisation.
  
  
**What We Expect**

* End-to-End Salesforce Delivery & Financial Ownership: Own the complete Salesforce delivery lifecycle, managing scope, timelines, risks, resourcing, and dependencies while ensuring high-quality outcomes and protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Agile Delivery Leadership: Lead Agile delivery using frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe, driving sprint execution, backlog prioritisation, delivery predictability, and high-performing cross-functional Salesforce teams.
* Program Planning & Roadmap Management: Develop and manage integrated project plans and delivery roadmaps, ensuring transparent progress reporting, risk visibility, and dependency management across the engagement lifecycle.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks from a delivery standpoint, establishing clear project tracking milestones for predictive and generative AI workstreams while managing downstream environment and data dependencies
* Stakeholder & Executive Management: Drive stakeholder alignment through effective communication, executive reporting, governance forums, and proactive escalation management in complex, global environments.
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by tracking and showcasing program metrics that prove the business value, sprint velocity gains, and adoption rates of deployed Salesforce capabilities to client leadership
* Quality Governance & Delivery Excellence: Establish and enforce delivery governance, standards, and best practices, ensuring compliance, quality benchmarks, and continuous improvement across projects.
* Champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants, and automated tracking to optimize implementation schedules and boost team development capacity
* Resource & Budget Management: Plan and optimise project resourcing, manage budgets and forecasts, track financials, and mitigate delivery and financial risks throughout the engagement.
* AI-Driven Productivity Enhancement: Encourage the strategic adoption of authorised AI technologies to boost team efficiency and optimise overall project delivery cycles.
* Timezone flexibility: Timezone flexibility to ensure comprehensive support and alignment with global customer needs.

**Requirements**
**Must Have**

* 10+ years of total experience in the IT industry, with 5+ years delivering Salesforce projects.
* Proven experience managing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ and Revenue Cloud.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce delivery lifecycle, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Architects and Technical Leads (hands-on configuration is not required).
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with senior stakeholders and executives.
* Salesforce Certifications (any one): Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Revenue Cloud or Experience Cloud Consultant.
* Project / Agile Management Certification (any one): PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2, CSM, or PSM.
* Hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smartsheets, Google Workspace.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.
* Willingness to travel on a need basis.

**Desirable/Nice to Have**

* Experience delivering Salesforce projects in Revenue OR CPQ
* Exposure to MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, or related integration and data platforms.

7cd7eb20.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
7cd7eb20.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Why should you apply to this role?**
The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large-scale Cloud migrations.
  
  
You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:**
Lead end-to-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
  
  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision-making through data-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support & engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:**
Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior-level decision-makers and c-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering  
Experience: 12+Years

Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune/Mumbai  
Employment Type: Full Time

Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.

Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane, The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.

Your future duties and responsibilities  
• Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.  
• Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.  
• Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.  
• Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.  
• Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.  
• Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.  
• Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.  
• Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.  
• Define AI governance with security and compliance: data residency, PII handling, prompt and output logging, human-in-the-loop gates, and model/version change control for government clients.  
• Drive urgency through time-boxed delivery: bias to 2–4 week proof points, kill or scale decisions on evidence, and visible burn-down of the riskiest unknowns first.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role  
Must to Have Skills:  
• Azure platform depth (primary cloud): AKS at multi-tenant production scale, Azure networking (VNet, Private Link, Front Door, App Gateway), Entra ID, Azure Policy and landing-zone/Well-Architected design, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, and cost management (FinOps, reservations, tagging, chargeback).  
• Azure services breadth: Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL), Managed Grafana, Key Vault, Storage, API Management, Functions and Container Apps, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, and DevOps/GitHub integration. • Observability: Understanding of OpenTelemetry-based stacks (traces, logs, metrics), sampling and retention economics, and alert tuning at scale.  
• CI/CD and GitOps: Understanding of GitHub Actions, Argo CD, incremental builds, and policy-as-code gates (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) with container signing and scanning.  
• Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management: Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, and configuration-in Git with drift detection.  
• Identity and security: Understanding of SSO, RBAC, and JIT access patterns (Entra ID, Keycloak); secrets and certificate lifecycle automation (Key Vault, cert-manager, ACME).  
• AI and GenAI fundamentals: LLM capabilities and limits, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured output and function/tool calling, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, token and inference cost management, and latency/quality trade-offs.  
• RAG and knowledge systems: chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search (Azure AI Search, pgvector, or equivalent), re-ranking, grounding and citation, retrieval evaluation, and mitigation of hallucination and data leakage.  
• Agentic and AI-assisted operations: multi-step agents and orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), Model Context Protocol (MCP) style tool integration, and evaluation and observability of AI systems (eval harnesses, golden datasets, tracing, drift monitoring).  
• Understanding of Azure AI stack: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model deployment and quota management, private networking for AI endpoints, content safety, and responsible-AI controls.  
• Hands-on engineering ability: comfortable in Python (and/or Go or TypeScript), Git-based workflows, SQL/KQL, and shipping working prototypes without waiting for a team to be assigned.  
• Program tooling fluency: PI and agile planning at scale, RICE or equivalent prioritization, and dependency and risk management.

Good-to-Have Skills:  
• 12+ years in technology, including 5+ years running multi-team technical programs (8–15 initiatives) as a TechPM, program lead, or platform delivery lead.  
• Operations transformation: moving support and operations organizations from reactive firefighting to problem management and SRE practices.  
• FOSS-biased platform strategy with explicit commercial buy triggers; hands-on vendor MSA negotiation.  
• Developer platform delivery (e.g., Backstage) and production delivery of AI-assisted operations — LLM assisted triage, RAG-backed knowledge and runbook assistants, and self-healing workflows with measured deflection.  
• Azure certifications or equivalent demonstrated depth (e.g., AZ-305 Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer, AI-102 Azure AI Engineer).  
• Active hands-on builder — personal projects, open-source contributions, or side builds using AI tooling; genuinely passionate about development and fast iteration.  
• Presenting to executive leadership: funding asks, program reviews, and candid at-risk status narratives.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**
