11728d01.description:
### Job Summary

The Customer Operations Transformation (COT) programme is a strategic initiative to simplify and standardize Customer Operations, enhance customer experience, and enable data-driven decision-making through digital capabilities and automation. The programme spans five strategic workstreams: OTIF, Joint Value Creation, Zero Touch Zero Delay, Zero Exceptions, and One Day Query Resolution.

The Project Manager is part of the COT programme team, working across Customer Operations, Order-to-Cash, Supply Chain, Commercial, Finance, Data & Technology, Regions & Markets, Service Delivery teams and Third-party partners to deliver complex, cross-functional change and measurable transformation outcomes.

### Purpose of Role

The Project Manager is responsible for driving COT projects from initiation through successful delivery, ensuring alignment to programme objectives, scope, timeline, budget, quality and benefits. The role combines strong PMO and project delivery discipline with data-driven performance management, enabling leadership to make informed decisions through clear KPIs, dashboards, reporting and insights. The role works closely with business and technology stakeholders to translate priorities into executable plans, manage dependencies and risks, maintain effective governance, and accelerate delivery through Agile and hybrid ways of working.

### Responsibilities

* Stakeholder & Team Coordination: Partner with Customer Operations, O2C, Supply Chain, Commercial, Finance, Data & Technology, Regions & Markets, Service Delivery and third-party partners to align priorities, activities and outcomes.
* Programme Planning & Delivery: Develop and maintain integrated programme/project plans, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps and milestones, ensuring delivery remains aligned to agreed scope, timelines and priorities.
* PMO Governance: Establish and operate effective programme governance, including governance forums, decision and action tracking, escalation management and executive reporting.
* RAID Management: Maintain and actively manage the programme RAID log covering Risks, Actions, Issues and Dependencies, ensuring clear ownership, mitigation, due dates and escalation.
* Dependency Management: Identify, track and resolve cross-squad, workstream, market, business, data and technology dependencies to support integrated delivery and protect timelines.
* Value & Benefits Tracking: Support the definition and tracking of business outcomes, KPIs, benefits and measurable value delivered through COT initiatives.
* Agile Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement: Drive effective Agile ways of working and identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, governance, reporting, team effectiveness and programme execution.
* Problem Solving & Delivery Support: Apply structured problem solving, critical thinking and stakeholder influencing to resolve challenges, support decisions, manage escalations and maintain delivery momentum.

### Key Competencies

#### Technical

* Extensive project planning and execution skills across complex change and transformation programmes/projects.
* Experience using Agile, Waterfall and hybrid project/change management methodologies.
* Strong PMO, governance, RAID, dependency, financial and benefits management capability.
* Ability to structure and communicate complex information through plans, dashboards, scorecards and executive reporting.
* Strong understanding of transformation delivery and programme lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in JIRA, Azzure Dev Ops, MS Project or similar project management tools, PowerPoint, Excel and other MS Office applications.
* Understanding of Order-to-Cash and Customer Operations processes; broader Finance/Supply Chain knowledge is advantageous.
* Understanding of Lean / Six Sigma and continuous improvement.

#### Behavioural / Leadership

* Excellent communication, documentation and presentation skills.
* Strong stakeholder management with a global mindset, including influencing, challenging and decision-making ability.
* Strong negotiation, collaboration and conflict-resolution skills.
* Self-driven, structured and outcome focused, with the ability to motivate cross-functional teams towards common goals.

### Qualifications and Experience Required

#### Education and Qualifications

* Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* Professional Project Management qualification preferred.
* Lean / Six Sigma certification preferred

**Pre-Sales Specialist**

involving requirements gathering, proposal development, customer presentations, RFP responses, internal coordination, service positioning, and opportunity support.

* Ask relevant follow-up questions and document customer requirements accurately.

34d00db9.title: CIS Presales Solution Architect
34d00db9.description:
**About The Role**
CIS Presales Solutions, you will make an impact by shaping and driving winnable, differentiated infrastructure solutions across Managed Services and Digital Transformation pursuits for clients in every vertical. You will be a valued member of the Cloud, Infrastructure and Security (CIS) Services Solution Group team and work collaboratively with onsite sales, solutions and delivery teams, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Take end-to-end responsibility for solution and commercial creation and integration, including running scoping workshops, questionnaires and solution discussions.
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to design differentiated, winnable solutions that meet customer requirements.
* Develop winning themes, SWOT and competitor analysis, and reusable bid components to maximise pursuit efficiency.
* Lead solution workshops, MVD/CAS sessions, due diligence and TPA engagements, interfacing directly with clients and advisors.
* Manage and mentor a team of junior and mid-level solution managers.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai or Bangalore, India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Strong techno-commercial capability with proven customer interaction and solution presentation skills.
* Solid IT infrastructure understanding across Compute (on-prem and cloud), Network, Security, End User and Service Management, including Managed Services and Digital Transformation.
* Knowledge of pricing models, IT spend analysis, business case development, and TCO and ROI analysis.
* Familiarity with service assurance and automation tools and ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Proven track record of delivering complex solutions in a fast-paced environment with strong problem-solving skills.

**These will help you succeed**

* Awareness of industry IT trends and analyst/TPA reports such as Gartner, Everest, Forrester, ISG, BCG, HfS and IDC.
* Experience in cross-cultural and leading global outsourcing organisations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* A flexible, self-motivated, can-do approach with the ability to work well under pressure.
* Flexibility to accommodate short domestic and international business travel.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

1409f582.title: Lead - Presales
1409f582.description:
**About Leadsquared**
LeadSquared is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000+ customers and 2.5 lakh+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.
  
  
**About The Role**
LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.
  
  
***🎓 This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Education — who understands enrollment funnels, student lifecycle management, and how institutions buy technology.***
**Solution Engineering**
**Product Demonstrations**
**RFP/RFI Response**
**CRM**
**EdTech**
**Higher Education**
**POC Development**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Demonstrations**

* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared’s CRM and Student Lifecycle Management platform for Higher Education, K-12, and EdTech prospects.
* Design and deliver discovery-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — enrollment management, student engagement, retention, and alumni relations.
* Develop and present end-to-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect’s administrative, enrollment, and technology workflows.
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.
* Showcase integration capabilities with SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool), LMS tools, and other education ecosystem technologies.

**RFP Leadership & Proposal Excellence**

* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Education prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.
* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Enrollment, and Provost-level audiences.
* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Education deployments.
* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Education team.

**Education Domain Authority**

* Serve as LeadSquared’s internal subject-matter expert on US Education: enrollment management, student success, financial aid workflows, and alumni engagement.
* Maintain competitive intelligence across EdTech CRM platforms (Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Ellucian CRM, Element451) and develop battle cards.
* Stay current on FERPA compliance, Title IV regulations, and accreditation-related technology requirements.
* Represent LeadSquared at US Education conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Engage VP Enrollment Management, CIOs, Registrars, Student Success Directors, and Provosts as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.
* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Education market requirements and competitive gaps.
* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Education vertical scales.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience & Education**

* 5-10 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Education accounts.
* Deep understanding of US Higher Education and/or K-12 institutional buying processes, IT governance, and technology procurement.
* Prior hands-on experience with EdTech CRM, SIS, or Student Lifecycle Management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US educational institution is a strong plus.
* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C-suite and VP-level academic leaders.

**Technical & Domain Skills**

* Strong understanding of enrollment management, student lifecycle, financial aid, and alumni engagement workflows.
* Familiarity with US Education technology ecosystem: SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus), LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L), and communication tools.
* Knowledge of FERPA, data privacy standards, and compliance requirements for US Education technology.
* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API-based connectivity for enterprise Education environments.
* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Element451, Ellucian CRM, or similar.

**Good to Have**

* Experience presenting at EDUCAUSE, NACAC, or similar US Education conferences.
* Familiarity with Title IV, accreditation body requirements, and financial aid system integrations.
* Experience with data analytics and reporting for student outcome tracking.

00001c50.title: Solutions Engineer
00001c50.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be in Global Enterprise Segment (GES) where we lead Cisco's top 500 strategic accounts. Our responsibility to Cisco’s business is phenomenal, and our responsibility to each other and our culture is greater. We have a dedicated focus on our customers' success, we are Cisco's growth engine and shape the company’s future. Our values customer focused Always, Show Up to Win Every Day, and Harness the Power of Cisco is how we get the job done, and our Win As One mentality embodies the spirit of the journey and how we will show up with each other, partners, and customers.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are looking for a Solutions Engineer (SE) with Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Collaboration, Security, Automation, and Cloud background. The SE role is a customer focused technical sales professional who ensures that technical information and guidance is provided to the customer, delivering meaningful outcomes based on Cisco’s product and services portfolio. You will partner with your Account Managers in a pre-sales technical function, showcasing Cisco solutions, providing customer presentations, performing technical demonstrations, creating BoM’s, and running proof of concept activities. SE’s partner, consult, influence and design solutions to allow the customer to meet their desired outcomes. In addition to technology proficiency and the ability to learn quickly and stay ahead of; the ideal candidate's interpersonal, presentation and troubleshooting skills should evoke passion and confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technology solution consultant to the customer and the Cisco account team.
* Leverage an array of Cisco technology, services, and support specialists.
* Collaborate closely with Account Manager on account planning activities.
* Educate the customer on Cisco differentiation, creating demand.
* Set brand preference to Cisco.
* Align Cisco’s product and services capabilities to customers business drivers.
* You are determined and have a long history in the Networking field.
* You will also have a strong background in large enterprises and/or large service provider IT accounts and understand how to engage new lines of business to drive understanding and preference to Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Internet of Things solutions.
* Strong business acumen and customer presence.
* Experience and comfort conversing with network and telecommunications managers as well as customer lines of business on Data Center, Security, and Retail solutions.
* As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be responsible for driving customer activities and discussions that lead to preference of Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Automation solutions.
* The focus of this position is to uncover business benefits for a customer by consulting on Cisco solutions and applications to solve business problems, working with multi-functional teams to design and present appropriate technical solution, and building joint plan of record for multiple engineering systems using Cisco products.
* You'll plan sales strategy, develop proposals, deliver customer presentations and demonstrations to close business and generate revenue.
* While customer facing engagements will be the primary role, other duties will include training colleagues on Data Center, Virtualization and MOCA topics and practices. Developing best practices in sales approaches and technical execution.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering or the broader computing/IT industry, with a strong focus on Cisco Enterprise Routing & Switching, Data Center, and Security solutions.
* In-depth knowledge of large IT environments and applications.
* Deep understanding and operational experience with a routed and switched data/voice network.
* Cisco product experience or relevant experience in key competitor offerings in technology area of emphasis required.
* Minimum CCNP or similar vendor certification required.
* Knowledge of Cisco's Solutions, networking fundamentals required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pre-Sales experience preferred.
* Typically requires BS/BA (EE/CS) or equivalent.
* Customer intimacy skills

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

f916a27d.title: Presales Specialist
f916a27d.description:
**Company Description**
Best International Project (BIP) is a global platform that showcases outstanding architecture, development, and design from around the world. The company highlights visionary creators behind landmark cultural institutions, luxury residences, and innovative technologies that transform the way people build and live. In addition to design features, BIP provides market intelligence, investment perspectives, and insights into luxury real estate and urban development. It serves as a destination for architects, developers, designers, investors, and industry leaders who seek exceptional projects with global impact. BIP invites forward-thinking firms to share their standout work and join a community that celebrates excellence and creative innovation.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Presales Specialist is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting the growth of BIP’s platform by discovering and engaging prospective clients and partners before the sales cycle formally begins. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing client needs, preparing tailored presentations and proposals, and demonstrating how BIP’s services and exposure can support their strategic goals. The role involves collaborating closely with the sales and editorial teams to shape compelling value propositions, responding to inquiries, and guiding potential clients through solution options. The Presales Specialist will also maintain accurate records in CRM tools, provide timely follow-up, and contribute to continuous improvement of presales processes and materials.
  
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess client needs, interpret market data, and build well-founded recommendations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to present solutions clearly, create persuasive proposals, and collaborate with internal teams.
* Candidates should possess Consulting skills to understand client objectives, offer strategic guidance, and align BIP’s offerings with business outcomes.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Presales skills to manage inquiries, provide responsive support, and nurture relationships throughout the evaluation process.
* Relevant experience in presales, business development, or client-facing roles, ideally within architecture, design, real estate, or media sectors.
* Comfort working in a remote environment, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Proficiency with CRM and presentation tools; fluency in English required, additional languages are an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

cab33db1.title: Solutions Engineer III
cab33db1.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

**How you’ll do it:**

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization

**What you’ll bring:**

* 10+ years of related industry experience with FSI & Enterprise background
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus

**What you’ll get:**

* This role is primarily based out of Mumbai with Hybrid mode.
* This is a self-driven role, so career growth and development is available at every stage of your career.
* Competitive pay, family friendly benefits, and cool perks
* Tuition assistance for professional development
* Culture of giving back, strong diversity and inclusion interest groups

The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.
  
  
**Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5.com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5.com or**
**@myworkday.com)**
**.**
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
It is the policy of F5 to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5.com.

a944954a.title: Solution Engineering - AIBS
a944954a.description:
**Overview**
The mission of AI Business Solutions - Biz Process is to help our customers digitally transform their businesses to drive new sources of revenue, create new and engaging ways to serve their customers, and to transform the way in which their business runs to drive new levels of profitability for their organization.
  
  
We at the India and South Asia Business Applications Solutions team are seeking a highly skilled AI Business Solution Engineer with a focus on Customer Engagement/Experience and Customer Service to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Sales, Service and Marketing management/automation technologies, paired with extensive experience in CRM presales.
  
  

As an AI Business Solution Engineer – Sales & Service, you will provide technology expertise to help win deals by guiding Microsoft customers to successfully evaluate our CRM solutions. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your selling skills, and become adept at deal structuring. The role may need 0-40% travel outside your base location.
  
  
In this role you will be the Solution Engineer (pre-sales consultant) for your assigned workload and a member of the sales team that consists of Solution Specialist, Customer Success Unit, partners, and engineering. In this role you will advance pipeline by assisting the Solution Specialist in qualifying the deal, developing the strategy, and inspiring the CxO/Business Decision Maker/Technical Decision Maker. You are responsible for designing/architecting the solution and delivering an industry-aligned demonstration to the customer. You will engage partners for co-sell and implementation considerations, engineering to assist with emerging technologies and Customer Success Unit for deal support. The demo will focus on solving the technical proof requirements while highlighting our business value and competitive differentiators and should result in securing the customer’s solution design endorsement. Once the solution design is secured, you will support the Solution Specialist in finalizing the customer proposal and assisting with licensing.
  
  
You will develop relationships with the decision makers with our customers and position yourself as a trusted advisor in your domain. As a recognized product expert, you are responsible for sharing your technical, industry knowledge and best practices with your peers.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Advance qualified pipeline revenue by demonstrating solution capabilities, addressing technical proof requirements, and securing the customer’s solution design endorsement.
* Engage with the account team to land solution envisioning sessions and business value assessments.
* Proactively deliver compelling customer centric solution demonstrations based on technical workload expertise while building Business Decision Maker/CxO/Technical Decision Maker connections.
* Address solution architecture considerations and competitive objection handling.

61824177.title: Solution Architect/ Field Application Engineer
61824177.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. * Key member for marketing events/trade shows.
* With 10+ years of relevant experience

**What We Need**

* Strong Python programming skills and deep familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow; experience with Generative AI, LLMs, vision models, model deployment, training, or fine-tuning is preferred.
* Experience designing scalable AI solutions and deploying applications in cloud environments, as well as guiding physically installing hardware servers, accelerator cards, and PCIe devices.
* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience with C++, CUDA, parallel programming, or kernel development is a plus.
* Language proficiency in English is required; Hindi or other Indian language proficiency is a plus.

**What You Will Learn**

* How to architect and deploy innovative AI/ML solutions across a wide range of customer use cases, including Generative AI and LLM applications.
* How to lead the full customer engagement lifecycle, from pre-sales technical discovery and demonstrations through proof-of-concept delivery and production deployment.

*Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.*
*This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.*

7b897afb.title: Job Opprotunity For Presales- AAA Senior Manager
7b897afb.description:
**Function**

Presales / Solution Consulting

**Experience**

10+ years

**Location**

Navi Mumbai

**Travel**

[~10%- 20% local, as per need basis]

**About the role**

We are hiring a senior presales leader to shape and win our most complex opportunities across application, automation, data and analytics, and AI.

This is a revenue-influencing role. You will run discovery with CXOs, frame the opportunity, orchestrate the response, build the business case, and carry the pursuit through to close. You will own the story we tell the client and the quality of what we put in front of them.

You are not expected to design the architecture yourself. Our solution architects and delivery leads do that. Your job is to bring them the right problem, shape their input into a coherent and compelling response, and make sure the client understands the value of it.

The work demands consulting judgment, executive presence, and commercial instinct. Technology fluency is a means to those ends, not the job itself.

**What you'll do**

**Client engagement and discovery**

* Engage CXOs and senior business and IT stakeholders to understand their challenges, objectives, and transformation roadmaps.
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into clearly framed problem statements and value propositions.
* Lead presentations, solution walkthroughs, and executive workshops, bringing in specialists where depth is needed.

**Opportunity shaping and orchestration**

* Qualify opportunities early and honestly and decide where to invest pursuit effort.
* Convene the right architects, delivery leads, and partners for each pursuit and direct their contributions toward a single coherent response.
* Challenge and pressure-test proposed approaches for feasibility, commercial viability, and client fit before they reach the customer.

**Pursuits and proposals**

* Lead RFP/RFI responses, proposals, solution presentations, SOWs, and executive narratives end to end.
* Own the win strategy on large pursuits: differentiation, risk posture, and competitive positioning.
* Hold the pen on the narrative and drive the pursuit calendar to submission.

**Commercial ownership**

* Quantify the return on proposed automation and AI initiatives: ROI, productivity gains, cost savings, and operational benefit.
* Contribute to pricing, estimation, TCO modeling, business cases, and deal qualification.
* Partner with account teams on new opportunities, cross-sell and up-sell, and account growth strategy.

**Capability building**

* Build reusable proposal assets, value frameworks, case studies, and qualification playbooks that shorten future sales cycles.
* Track market and technology shifts closely enough to keep our positioning current and credible.

**Technology fluency [good to have]**

Should include working knowledge of:

* Application development and modernization, APIs, microservices, cloud, and enterprise architecture concepts.
* RPA and intelligent automation platforms, and where they do and don't apply.
* Data and analytics: BI, data engineering, and modern data platforms.
* AI/ML and Generative AI, including LLMs, RAG, agentic patterns, and AI governance.
* At least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Enterprise security, integration, governance, and compliance considerations at a conversational level.

Depth in two or three of these is valuable. Breadth across all of them matters more, because your role is to see the whole opportunity rather than one layer of it.

**Presales and consulting skills**

* Demonstrated success in enterprise presales, solution consulting, or bid leadership.
* Track record of independently owning large RFP/RFI and proposal engagements from qualification to submission.
* Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to hold both a CIO and an engineering team in the same room.
* Strong commercial instincts: pricing, estimation, ROI and TCO, business cases, and knowing which deals to walk away from.
* Experience with global clients and distributed sales and delivery teams.
* The ability to influence without authority and coordinate specialists who don't report to you.
* Flexible to work in a global role

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's or masters degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years across technology consulting, presales, bid management, or client-facing transformation roles.

**Preferred**

* AI, automation, analytics, or architecture certifications.
* Background in IT services, consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation organizations.
* Experience supporting enterprise deals valued at $1M+.

**How success is measured**

* Presales win rate and pipeline contribution
* Revenue generated and influenced through AI, automation, and analytics solutions
* Proposal and RFP quality, and turnaround time
* Client engagement quality and executive stakeholder satisfaction
* Qualification discipline: pursuit effort concentrated on winnable deals
* Reusable proposal and value assets created
* Quantifiable client ROI and delivered business outcomes

**The ideal candidate**

A consultative leader who closes the gap between a client's business problem and an AI- or automation-led answer to it. Someone who can sit in a CXO conversation, leave with the real problem rather than the stated one, and then marshal a technical team into a response that wins. Someone who owns the narrative, the numbers, and the deadline.

  

If interested, please share your updated resume to priyadharshani.p@3i-infotech.com

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

***OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE***

As a **Senior Cloud Platform Architect**, you will provide architectural leadership for Takeda’s hybrid-cloud networking and security capabilities across **AWS and Azure**.

The role’s primary focus is to maintain and continuously improve the mature AWS cloud networking platform while leading the development of Azure into an enterprise-ready platform with comparable capabilities, governance, security, automation, and operational maturity.

You will:

* Serve as the subject-matter expert for hybrid-cloud networking, connectivity, segmentation, traffic inspection, and cloud security architecture.
* Maintain and improve AWS networking posture across the existing landing zone, ensuring scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and operational effectiveness.
* Design and mature the Azure platform, including secure connectivity to Takeda’s internal network and support for application deployment across AWS and Azure.
* Establish consistent multi-cloud architecture patterns using AWS, Azure, Aviatrix, Palo Alto Networks, and infrastructure as code.
* Define cloud networking and security standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and operational practices.
* Enable application and product teams to deploy secure, compliant, and well-connected workloads across AWS and Azure.
* Contribute to cloud strategy, governance, service models, and the hybrid-cloud operating model.
* Lead continuous improvement of platform capabilities through automation, standardization, and engineering excellence.

* ACCOUNTABILITIES
* Lead the architecture, governance, and continuous improvement of hybrid-cloud networking across AWS, Azure, Aviatrix, and Palo Alto Networks.
* Maintain and improve the mature AWS landing-zone networking posture, including connectivity, routing, segmentation, traffic inspection, DNS, resiliency, security, and performance.
* Lead the development and maturation of the Azure platform, including secure connectivity and support for application deployment across AWS and Azure.
* Define reusable multi-cloud network and security patterns using AWS and Azure native services, Aviatrix, Palo Alto Networks, and Terraform.
* Establish standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and operating practices for cloud networking, security, monitoring, governance, and compliance.
* Design and govern connectivity using services such as AWS Transit Gateway, RAM, Direct Connect, VPN, PrivateLink, Route 53, Network Firewall, Azure ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, and Private Link.
* Implement and integrate cloud security and monitoring capabilities, including GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, Inspector, Macie, CloudWatch, SIEM, SOC, and SOAR solutions.
* Ensure cloud infrastructure and network configurations are automated, tested, version-controlled, and maintained through Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Provide architecture reviews, technical leadership, troubleshooting support, and guidance for complex cloud networking, security, connectivity, and platform initiatives.
* Partner with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, infrastructure, operations, application, and compliance teams to enable secure, reliable, and scalable cloud adoption.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, lead proofs of concept, and drive continuous improvement in platform maturity, resiliency, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.
* Communicate the health, risks, roadmap, and strategic direction of AWS and Azure platform capabilities to relevant stakeholders.
* EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:
* Required:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 8+ years of experience across cloud architecture, enterprise networking, infrastructure, security, DevOps, or operations.
* 5+ years of experience designing and implementing AWS networking and hybrid-cloud architectures.
* Experience designing or maturing Azure platforms and hybrid connectivity.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of AWS networking, cloud security, routing, DNS, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Aviatrix multi-cloud networking.
* Strong understanding of network segmentation, centralized inspection, zero-trust principles, and least-privilege access.
* Experience integrating cloud monitoring and security services with enterprise SIEM, SOC, or SOAR platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Preferred:
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent.
* Experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated industry.

* Experience with Azure ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, Private Link, and private endpoints.
* Experience implementing cloud governance, compliance controls, and policy as code.
* Familiarity with GxP, SOX, GDPR, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, or similar requirements.

8d9c2daa.title: DE - AE- AI Architect-SM-GDS04
8d9c2daa.description:
Location: Noida

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 6, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1748312

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Senior AI Architect**

  

**Experience**

* 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

  

**Role focus**

* AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

  

**The opportunity**

We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption.

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes.

  

**Key responsibilities**

**AI and solution architecture**

* Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations.
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows.
* Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant.
* Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost.

**Java/J2EE engineering and modernization**

* Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs.
* Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns.
* Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity.
* Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management.
* Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability.

**Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering**

* Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components.
* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback.
* Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost.
* Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback.
* Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment.

**Governance, security and responsible AI**

* Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design.
* Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk.
* Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

**Consulting, leadership and capability building**

* Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business goals into AI roadmaps, solution options, implementation plans and clear value cases.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership and communicate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks and outcomes in executive-ready language.
* Provide technical leadership for pursuits, proposals, solutioning and estimation, including architecture narratives and delivery models.
* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.
* Create reusable accelerators, reference implementations, knowledge assets and engineering standards for the EAT competency.

  

**Qualifications and experience**

* **Education:** BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline.
* **Overall experience:** 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery.
* **Java/J2EE depth:** 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience.
* **Architecture depth:** 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture.
* **AI delivery:** 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery.
* **Leadership:** Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes.
* **Consulting:** Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills.

  

**Mandatory technical skills**

**Capability & Expected proficiency**

* **Enterprise engineering -** Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* **Integration and platforms -** API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
* **GenAI and agentic AI -** LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
* **AI frameworks -** Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
* **Data and retrieval -** SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j
* **Cloud AI -** At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
* **Operationalization -** CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support
* **Security and governance -** Identity and access, OAuth/OIDC or SAML, data protection, AI safety, Responsible AI, model risk and secure AI service integration

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Python and AI service development using FastAPI or Flask, alongside the primary Java/J2EE engineering background.
* Fine-tuning concepts, model optimization, quantization, open-source models and multimodal AI.
* GraphRAG, Knowledge-Augmented Generation, enterprise knowledge platforms and advanced retrieval/evaluation patterns.
* Workflow orchestration or BPM platforms such as Camunda, Airflow or Prefect.
* Infrastructure as Code and platform engineering using tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Experience across regulated industries and familiarity with enterprise privacy, security and compliance expectations.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Java or AI certifications; contributions to internal accelerators, open-source projects or technical communities.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Provides technical expertise through customer presentations, product demonstrations, installation, of company products and solutions. Assists the sales staff in assessing potential application of company products to meet customer needs and preparing detailed product specifications for the development and implementation of customer applications/solutions. May build POCs based on customer requirements to demonstrate feasibility of the application/solution, often requiring rapid prototyping and/or product demo for client. May provide software development and consultation to customers and/or product capability assessment and validation. Ensures that the product application/solution is functioning according to specifications. May provide follow-up support to Sales, Ops and customer personnel by disseminating technical information on specific applications/solutions

Define the overall architecture, external interfaces and detailed functional description of the solution
  
  
Perform technical evaluations of major system enhancements and major new customer requirements
  
  
Create detailed system level functional requirements and specifications

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a global leader in Advisory, Assurance, Tax, and Transaction Services. In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the End User Technology Experience team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.

development expertise.

* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Demonstrate excellent technical & architecture skills in the context of cloud-based platform/product design, service management and product lifecycle management
* Demonstrate ability to rapidly learn new and emerging technologies and developing a vision of their suitability
* Serves as the lead solution architect for customer service solutions
* Experience with Microsoft Teams and Dynamics 365
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure IaaS and PaaS services
* Experience with Business Intelligence analytic tools
* Designed, validated, and implemented PowerApps and Power BI solutions
* Platform Expertise using Microsoft Graph, Power Apps, Flow and market place apps
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, BOT Framework, RPA and virtual agents
* Knowledge of python, AI stacks, CNN’s, RNN’s, AI Fluency, NLP, Digital Twins, Metaverse, Data preprocessing.
* Knowledge of UI/UX, branding, and document management, Custom solutions development, search and metadata configuration, business analysis, business process automation, and workflows. Microsoft PowerApps and Microsoft Flow, SharePoint Technologies (Windows SharePoint Services, SharePoint Server, InfoPath Forms
* Services, Forms, PowerShell scripts, Migration tools (Sharegate, DocAve, Cloudiway), Excel Services, Search,
* Business Data Catalog and Web Services), PowerApps, Flow, Power BI, Security & Compliance, Data Governance, Classic and Modern UI, PowerShell, PowerApps, Flow
* Knowledge of Intranets, public websites, applications, Proposal Management Systems, Project Management
* Information Systems, product or service sites, business development, process automation with forms and workflows.
* Knowledge of Classic and Modern UI, Power BI and SharePoint integration & so as building knowledge of automated process and workflows (using various tools & technologies).
* Knowledge of Agile Development, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), System Development Life Cycle
* Methodology (SDLCM), Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF), Microsoft Solutions Framework (MSF)
* Build technical artifacts for Engineering and product owners
* Brings proven industry leading technical expertise of the product(s)

**Other Requirements:**

1d75910d.title: Consulting Architect - Search

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

a4b752f3.title: Consulting Architect - Platform
a4b752f3.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

This role requires strong technical proficiency across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and governance services, as well as the ability to partner with engineering, operations, and security teams to ensure a resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud platform. The Azure Engineer plays a critical role in enabling cloud adoption, supporting infrastructure modernization initiatives, and maintaining the overall health and stability of the organization's Azure ecosystem.**

  

**Experience: 5-9 years**

**Location: Hyderabad**

  

**Role & responsibilities:**

  

* Ensure the health and stability of cloud services through proactive monitoring, Terraform-based infrastructure management, Azure platform administration, and the successful delivery of cloud infrastructure solutions that enable business and application teams to operate securely and efficiently.
* Provide essential operational support for Azure-hosted services, ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of key business platforms. With dedicated ownership of these responsibilities, operational incidents would experience increased resolution times, elevated service risk, and a greater likelihood of business disruption.
* Responsible for driving the identification, prioritization, and remediation of security findings across the Azure environment, directly reducing organizational risk and ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Enables critical project delivery, supports enterprise initiatives, and ensures Azure services remain secure, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

  

**If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!**

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 3+ years Azure cloud experience
* Experience in Azure technologies including but not limited to backup and restore, ASR, Network, NSG, troubleshooting and operational logging
* Experience in azure network design including NSG, Gateway, Firewalls, Subnets, Vnets. Knowledge of azure security constructs
* Demonstrated experience supporting production Azure deployments
* Demonstrated experience with Azure coding technologies CLI, Powershell, ARM
* Experience with Terraform deployments using Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab
* Experience working with teams to deliver complete azure solutions (security, operations, engineering, application team)
* Azure Administrator Certified

  

**Additional Requirements**

  

* Understanding of container technology and container orchestration platforms, Dockers, Kubernetes
* Knowledge of best practices and market trends pertaining to Cloud and overall industry to provide thought leadership (seminars, whitepapers etc.,) and mentor team to build necessary competency
* Advise the customer executives on their cloud strategy roadmap, improvements, alignment and further improvements.
