d5e21d3c.title: Oracle Cloud PPM Functional Support Consultant Level 2 (IDC)
d5e21d3c.description:
**Company Description**
Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
  
  
We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:
  
  

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
  
  
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.
  
  
This is a process-driven, customer-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL-aligned support environment.
  
  
You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
You will deliver day-to-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.
  
  
As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 & L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.
  
  
You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.
  
  
Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.
  
  
You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.
  
  
Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.
  
  
You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* 2-3 years of overall Experience working in an application support or service desk role
* Hands on experience of implementation and supporting the Projects Module in Cloud
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift-based model and collaborate across global teams

**Desirable Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems

**Key Behaviours & Attributes**

* Customer-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams

**Additional Information**
**Why Version 1?**
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
  
  
Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.
  
  
We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

4e565afd.title: ServiceNow-Service Now Architect - ITOM-Manager
4e565afd.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Manager - ITOM Technical Architect**
As part of our EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using the ServiceNow platform, specifically focusing on IT Operations Management (ITOM). You will get an opportunity to work with a high-quality team and build innovative solutions that address complex enterprise challenges.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for a Technical Architect with expertise in ServiceNow ITOM architecture and implementation to join the EY GDS ServiceNow team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in driving ITOM transformation and platform strategy for global clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management
* Define and implement scalable CMDB architecture, governance frameworks, and data models
* Drive end-to-end ITOM strategy, aligning ServiceNow capabilities with enterprise IT operations and business goals
* Architect and deliver event correlation, observability, and AIOps solutions using ServiceNow Event Management and integrations
* Design and implement Service Mapping solutions for business services and applications
* Lead Discovery implementation, including MID Server setup, credential management, and troubleshooting
* Drive integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and third-party monitoring tools
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to development and implementation teams
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical and architectural specifications
* Ensure adherence to platform best practices, governance, and security standards
* Support performance tuning, scalability optimization, and platform upgrades
* Drive DevOps and Agile delivery practices across ITOM implementations
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, Cloud Management
* Deep understanding of CMDB data modeling, CSDM framework, and data governance
* Experience in AIOps, event correlation, and monitoring tool integrations (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds)
* Knowledge of infrastructure technologies: servers, networks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong JavaScript, Glide scripting, and ServiceNow platform development skills
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* Approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with significant exposure to ServiceNow ITOM
* Proven experience as a Technical Architect or Lead in ServiceNow ITOM implementations
* ServiceNow CSA certification (mandatory)
* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery / Service Mapping (mandatory)
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred)

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with CSDM adoption and enterprise CMDB strategy
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments and cloud discovery
* Knowledge of latest ServiceNow releases and features

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with strong technical expertise, consulting mindset, and innovation-driven approach
* Individuals passionate about digital transformation and IT operations modernization
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced global environment
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

b191299e.description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
****Position Responsibilities****

* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience: 12y+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance & core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design & Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y+ experience using GIT based continuous integration & delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

**Role & responsibilities**

Job Purpose / Summary

The **Service Delivery Lead Finance & Accounts (F&A)** will be responsible for end-to-end delivery of F&A services across multiple locations, ensuring high-quality execution, adherence to SLAs and KPIs, and effective stakeholder engagement. The role will serve as the single point of accountability for service performance, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across business units.

Job Description

The Service Delivery Lead will oversee the comprehensive delivery of Finance & Accounts services across multiple locations and business units. The role requires a strategic and experienced leader with strong expertise in finance operations, service delivery, governance, and stakeholder management.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring seamless execution of F&A processes, including **Procure to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), Record to Report (R2R), and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**, while partnering closely with respective Centers of Excellence (COEs).

The role will focus on driving service excellence, standardization, process harmonization, continuous improvement, automation, and digitization. The incumbent will also manage escalations, build strong relationships with business stakeholders and leadership teams, and drive a high-performance culture across geographically distributed teams.

* Own and manage end-to-end F&A service delivery across **P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A**.

* Ensure adherence to defined **SLAs, KPIs, controls, and operational metrics**.
* Drive standardization and harmonization of processes across multiple locations.
* Monitor service performance and proactively manage escalations to ensure timely resolution.

* Define, track, and manage SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics, including preparation of dashboards and performance reports.
* Lead **weekly, monthly, and quarterly governance reviews** with stakeholders and leadership.
* Manage cross-location F&A teams, including performance management, coaching, capability building, and succession planning.
* Drive a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Identify opportunities for **process improvement, automation, digitization, and cost optimization**.
* Lead and implement **Lean Six Sigma / continuous improvement initiatives**.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Oversee billing and ensure timely collections in coordination with relevant teams.
* Drive effective change management and support transformation initiatives across F&A operations.

* Strong project management experience delivering Oracle ERP transformation and application initiatives.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, resource management, risk management, issue resolution, and change control.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and executive reporting skills.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities.
* Experience driving governance, compliance, quality assurance, and delivery excellence across large-scale Oracle programs.
* Ability to lead geographically distributed teams and manage multiple priorities in fast-paced delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Oracle EBS R12/R12.2 architecture and enterprise application landscape.
* Experience managing data migration, application modernization, cloud transformation, and enterprise integration initiatives.
* Knowledge of Oracle EBS modules, including Financials, Procurement, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Projects, and related business functions.
* Understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications architecture, SaaS delivery model, and Fusion ERP, SCM, HCM, and PPM modules.

* Understanding of Oracle Fusion configuration, personalization, extensions, reporting, and cloud integration approaches.
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, middleware concepts, and integration patterns.
* Understanding of Oracle Forms, Reports, BI Publisher, SQL, PL/SQL, XML Publisher, and enterprise reporting solutions.

4da590c4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, ShipTech
4da590c4.description:
**Description**
We're seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead complex logistics and transportation projects from conception to delivery. You'll coordinate cross-functional teams, manage timelines and dependencies, track progress against key metrics, and remove obstacles to accelerate project completion. The ideal candidate combines technical understanding with strong program management skills, excellent communication abilities, and proven success delivering high-impact initiatives on schedule and within scope.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Work with Internal & External Stakeholders to understand the business processes and workflows.
  
  
Develop functional specifications/requirements documents.
  
  
Deal with ambiguity to discover the true requirements underlying new feature requests; recommend alternative technical approaches and lead engineering efforts to meet constrained timelines.
  
  
Work with software and operations teams to launch projects and provide ongoing technical support
  
  
Track and review program updates with stakeholders and leaders
  
  
Work within and outside Amazon to encourage a fast and smooth adoption of the available services.
  
  
Be the primary conduit for gathering requirements for enhancements; develop demos, sample and technical collateral as required.
  
  
Work as the product owner and define roadmap in association with the stakeholders
  
  
Drive simplification and efficiencies in engineering and/or complex architectures to unblock innovation and/or speed of delivery within program area
  
  
Manage multiple projects in program area or large challenging projects to meet business and/or organization goals
  
  
Facilitate technical trade-offs between short term team needs and long term business needs
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon delivers millions of packages to customers worldwide, while providing world class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Amazon businesses continue to experience a rapid expansion into new markets and geographies. Our Transportation Technology division builds platforms that manage the lifecycle of a package. We are at the heart of Amazon's worldwide transportation operations and systemically integrate with supply chain to improve customer experience and reduce operational costs.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 4+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 4+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Exposure to software product architecture solutioning and design

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8af622e4.title: Technical Program Manager - GIOC
8af622e4.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is expanding its India presence and building its first Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai — a 24x7 command center for monitoring, triage, coordination, and incident resolution across Vultr's global infrastructure and operations.
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the end-to-end build and operational readiness of the GIOC. You will coordinate the onboarding of Systems, Network, Security, Platforms, and Tooling teams, while expanding the command center's scope to include DC Operations, Physical Security/GSOC, SRE, and Corporate IT.
  
  
You will drive cross-functional execution across monitoring, observability, automation, alert correlation, dashboards, operational processes, and team onboarding. Working closely with engineering teams, US-based Program Managers, India leadership, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that dependencies are managed, decisions are made, risks are surfaced early, and the GIOC is delivered on schedule and ready for 24x7 operations.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The TPM is the program backbone of the GIOC build and transformation. You will own the integrated program plan across multiple technical and operational workstreams, translating strategy into executable plans and ensuring delivery against committed milestones.
  
  
This is a highly technical program-management role. You should understand infrastructure, monitoring, observability, alerting, incident management, and engineering delivery well enough to challenge assumptions, write credible requirements, participate in technical discussions, and identify dependencies and risks — without being responsible for hands-on engineering.
  
  
Success will be measured by GIOC launch readiness, on-time delivery of critical workstreams, successful team onboarding, quality and adoption of program artifacts, automation and dashboard adoption, and proactive resolution of risks and dependencies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**GIOC Program & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end program management for the GIOC build, transformation, and operational-readiness roadmap.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate multiple parallel workstreams across Systems, Network, Security, Platforms, Tooling, DC Ops, Physical Security/GSOC, SRE, and Corp IT.
* Track execution against committed milestones and proactively course-correct schedule, scope, and resource risks.
* Serve as the central point of accountability for overall GIOC program status.

GIOC Onboarding & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Coordinate onboarding of technical and operational teams into the GIOC.
* Define onboarding plans, milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and operational readiness gates.
* Establish clear handoff requirements between engineering teams and GIOC operations.
* Track monitoring, alerting, escalation, documentation, access, staffing, and operational readiness requirements.
* Drive cutover, go-live, and post-launch hypercare activities. Automation, Observability & Consolidated Monitoring
* Drive cross-functional programs for automation, alert correlation, observability, and operational tooling.
* Coordinate delivery of a consolidated monitoring and operational dashboard covering onboarded GIOC services.
* Track dashboard coverage, alert quality, automation adoption, and identified observability gaps.
* Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements based on operational impact.

**Technical Requirements & Documentation**

* Author clear and actionable PRDs for GIOC tooling, dashboards, automation, integrations, and operational capabilities.
* Translate operational requirements into engineering-ready requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain program plans, decision logs, RAID logs, requirements traceability, and operational readiness documentation.
* Ensure key architectural, process, and scope decisions are documented and communicated.

Agile Execution & Engineering Partnership
  
  

* Translate program priorities into sprint-level execution in partnership with engineering teams.
* Challenge estimates, dependencies, assumptions, and delivery risks when required.
* Ensure engineering deliverables remain aligned with operational requirements and GIOC objectives.

**Stakeholder & Executive Management**

* Partner with US-based Program Managers and engineering leaders to align priorities, dependencies, and timelines across geographies.
* Coordinate India-based stakeholders across Infrastructure Operations, Engineering, Security, SRE, DC Operations, GSOC, and Corp IT.
* Prepare executive-level program reviews covering progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and required actions.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and secure executive buy-off on scope, priorities, and key program decisions.

**Risk, Dependency & Governance Management**

* Own program-level RAID management across GIOC workstreams.
* Identify critical-path risks and cross-team dependencies before they affect delivery.
* Drive blockers to resolution through structured escalation and stakeholder coordination.
* Establish program governance, reporting cadence, decision forums, and escalation mechanisms.
* Lead program retrospectives and drive continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–9 years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, Program Manager, or Project Manager in cloud infrastructure, data center, networking, security, SRE, or engineering environments.
* Proven experience delivering complex, multi-team technical programs from requirements through production/operational readiness.
* Strong practical understanding of infrastructure monitoring, observability, alerting, incident management, and system dependencies.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams and translating operational/business requirements into technical requirements or PRDs.
* Experience managing agile/scrum delivery across multiple engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex dependencies, risks, blockers, and critical-path activities.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and senior/executive stakeholders.
* Strong communication, documentation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments with multiple concurrent priorities.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building, launching, or scaling a NOC, SOC, GIOC, command center, or 24x7 operations environment.
* Experience with automation, alert correlation, observability, or enterprise monitoring programs.
* Familiarity with tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, Power BI, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar program/ITSM platforms.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, networking, data centers, security operations, or SRE environments.
* PMP, CSM, PMI-ACP, or SAFe certification.

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C-Suite level.
* High-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate-related goals.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.
  
  
The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.

**Role description**

Job Title: Specialist - Architecture  
Location: Coimbatore  
Experience: 5-7 years

Recruiter: Monica.sharma@ltm.com

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Specialist - Architecture to design, develop, and implement advanced AI and automation solutions. This role focuses on leveraging Azure AI services and the Microsoft Power Platform to create intelligent agents, chatbots, and robust automation workflows for enterprise applications.

Job Description:  
1. Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end intelligent agents and chatbots leveraging Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Bot Framework, and Copilot Studio, integrated with Power Automate.  
2. Implement advanced prompt engineering strategies and system instructions using Python and Power Automate for diverse enterprise applications, including ticketing, helpdesk, and software installation agents.  
3. Develop and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Azure AI Search, embedding models, vector indexing, and hybrid retrieval strategies. Create and maintain Python/Flask APIs for data retrieval, structured responses, and file handling.  
4. Manage robust authentication mechanisms (OAuth, AAD, managed identities) and configure bot deployments across various channels such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Azure App Services.  
5. Integrate knowledge bases with enterprise document repositories like SharePoint and OneDrive to enable context-aware and accurate agent responses.  
6. Facilitate API-driven integration of chatbots and agents with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Outlook/Teams for conversational automation and real-time actions.  
7. Design and implement automated remediation workflows for infrastructure incidents using Azure Event Grid, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Monitor. Develop AIOps capabilities for intelligent correlation and anomaly detection.  
8. Build, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models using frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn within the Azure infrastructure. Construct user-facing analytics dashboards using Power BI and Gradio. Implement responsible AI governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with security and data residency standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Mandatory Skills:  
Azure AI  
Python

Technical Skills:  
Azure AI Core: Azure AI, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure ML.  
Azure Platform: Bot Service, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, App Services, Event Grid, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Container Service (ACS).  
Microsoft Stack: Bot Framework SDK, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Office 365, Microsoft Teams integration.  
Development: Python, Flask, FastAPI, PowerShell, REST API design, structured JSON, file handling (PDF/image).  
AI/ML Concepts: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vectors, Embedding models, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, LangChain/Semantic Kernel.  
Visualization: Power BI, Gradio dashboards for AI observability.

Experience:  
5-7 years of professional experience in architecture, development, and implementation of AI and automation solutions.  
Proven experience in designing and deploying scalable, secure, and high-performance AI systems.  
Demonstrated ability to work with complex enterprise environments and integrate diverse systems.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

289bee68.title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
289bee68.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
* Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.

16e74529.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Google Cloud Generative AI Solution Lead you will guide client-facing data engineering efforts focused on Google Cloud and generative AI solutions, shaping data pipelines, integration approaches, and transformation work that supports actionable insights and informed decisions within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Manager you will lead complex programs, apply sound judgment, coach teams through ambiguity, and use your influence to move work forward while translating business needs into clear technical direction. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore, you will draw on your experience in data infrastructure, cloud-based solution design, and stakeholder communication to support delivery across modern data environments and contribute to work that spans Data Modernisation and Data, Analytics & AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading Google Cloud generative AI solution design and delivery for data modernization initiatives
* Advising client stakeholders on generative AI use cases, platform strategy, and implementation approaches
* Translating business needs into technical architectures across data pipelines, integration, transformation, and analytics layers
* Directing teams through complex delivery efforts involving data engineering, AI integration, and cloud-based platforms
* Applying knowledge of Google Cloud, data engineering platforms, and modern warehouse technologies to build scalable solutions
* Coordinating data modeling, data quality, validation, and performance tuning activities across solution components
* Guiding the use of AI fluency, agile scalability, and rapid experimentation to advance solution development
* Coaching team members on technical direction, issue resolution, and delivery priorities across multiple workstreams
* Validating technical outcomes with client leaders and adjusting designs based on feedback and business objectives
* Promoting professional and technical standards while supporting operational excellence across engagements

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 14+ years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
* Demonstrating Google Cloud generative AI solution delivery across client-facing engagements
* Applying data modernization methods across analytics and engineering platforms
* Crafting executive-ready messages that explain complex AI solutions
* Directing teams through ambiguity while balancing escalation and action
* Validating client outcomes and incorporating feedback into solution design
* Coaching cross-functional teams through large-scale technical programs

b94c23ba.description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12853
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/1/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**IAM Architect / Lead Consultant (Microsoft Entra ID & CloudGate Migration):**
Seeking an experienced Global Tenant-to-Tenant IAM Architect with strong Microsoft Entra ID expertise to lead discovery, assessment, solution design, implementation, and migration activities for a global identity transformation program. The consultant will assess the current Entra ID environments, evaluate migration options to CloudGate IDP, configure Entra ID, identify risks, and provide strategic recommendations for large-scale identity modernization initiatives involving more than 50,000 identities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead IAM discovery workshops and stakeholder engagements.
* Assess existing identity architecture, authentication flows, application integrations, and dependencies.
* Design target-state architecture and migration strategy.
* Evaluate Entra ID to CloudGate IDP migration feasibility, including feature mapping, gap analysis, and coexistence approach.
* Design and implement Entra ID solutions, including:

+ SSO, Federation, MFA
+ Conditional Access
+ Identity Governance
+ Access Reviews
+ Entitlement Management
+ Provisioning and Lifecycle Management
+ Enterprise Application Integrations

* Assess Microsoft 365 identity and workload impacts.
* Identify migration risks, assumptions, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Develop assessment reports, architecture documents, migration roadmaps, and runbooks.
* Support testing, pilot execution, cutover planning, and hypercare.
* Present recommendations and implementation plans to customer and Fujitsu stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* 8+ years of IAM experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Experience implementing and configuring Entra ID security and identity services.
* Proven experience with IAM platform migrations, tenant consolidations, or identity transformation programs.
* Strong knowledge of:

+ SSO, Federation, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC
+ SCIM Provisioning
+ MFA and Conditional Access
+ Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Entitlement Management
+ Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

* Experience integrating enterprise applications with identity providers.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 identity architecture and migration impacts.
* Experience with large-scale environments (50,000+ identities preferred).
* Customer-facing consulting, architecture, documentation, and presentation experience.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with CloudGate IDP or similar IAM platforms such as Okta, SailPoint, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, One Identity, or CyberArk Identity.
* Experience performing feature parity and capability assessments between Entra ID and third-party IAM platforms.
* Experience designing hybrid identity architectures involving AD, Entra ID, and third-party IDPs.
* Experience migrating SSO-integrated and provisioned applications between identity platforms.

**Mandatory Experience**

* Global identity transformation, tenant consolidation, merger/divestiture, or IAM migration programs.
* Multi-geo and multinational customer environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID services in production environments using various migration tools.
* Migration assessments between Entra ID and third-party IAM/IDP platforms.
* Assessment of migration impacts across Microsoft 365, Federation, MFA, Conditional Access, Identity Governance, Provisioning, Lifecycle Management, and Privileged Access.
* Production of executive-level assessment reports, migration roadmaps, and implementation recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience in both Entra ID implementation and identity platform migration projects, including feature parity assessments, migration planning, coexistence strategies, governance, security controls, and application integration impacts.

Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

4f5108cb.title: FinOps Lead, Redwood R&D
4f5108cb.description:
**About the Role**

Redwood is scaling public cloud infrastructure and AI features across multiple product lines, and we need a FinOps Lead to bring rigor, visibility, and accountability to that spend. This is a senior individual-contributor role with the authority to drive cross-functional cost governance directly. This role owns the translation of raw cloud cost data and AI spent into the models, forecasts, and governance mechanisms that let engineering, product, and executive leadership make informed decisions. This is not a bill-monitoring role. You will build the cost attribution infrastructure that ties cloud/AI spend to specific product lines and, ultimately, to ROI involving architecture and engineering teams to make the right trade offs and decisions in line with the strategic roadmap.

The role will report to the Senior Director, Product Engineering Operations, and work closely with Cloud Engineering, the CPO's org, and engineering leadership to create cost visibility and defensibility informing leadership on efficiency strategies. Your ability to be an effective communicator, collaborative team player, and analytical thinker will be keys to success in this role.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

**Cost Visibility, Attribution & Optimization**

* Own and continuously improve cost models that attribute AWS (and other public cloud) spend by product line, team, and environment
* Drive tagging governance and hygiene, define standards, audit compliance, and close attribution gaps that prevent accurate cost-per-product reporting
* Build shared cost allocation models to drive transparency into per-team cost drivers where there are prevalent savings plans, reserved instances and network charges
* Build toward feature-level cost attribution that connects infrastructure spend to product ROI, not just aggregate bill totals
* Create and manage optimization programs with achievable savings targets, including working across engineering and finance to rightsize, clean up and modernize infrastructure

**Forecasting & Reporting**

* Forecast cloud and AI/LLM API spend against budget; monitor forecast drivers and maintain accuracy over time
* Develop and maintain predictive cost models for AI/LLM services, factoring in variable consumption patterns (token usage, model selection) to improve long-term forecast accuracy
* Own recurring cost reporting cadences (monthly/quarterly) for engineering leadership and executive materials
* Track and report on discount utilization (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans) and flag roll-off risk before it hits the P&L

**Governance & Partnership**

* Partner with Cloud Engineering to design and drive public cloud spend management programs, including guardrails on provisioning and spend approval thresholds
* Participate in architecture and design reviews where infrastructure decisions carry meaningful cost implications by bringing cost tradeoffs into the conversation before decisions ship
* Identify and drive optimization opportunities (rightsizing, waste elimination, commitment planning) in partnership with engineering owners

**Analysis & Ad Hoc Support**

* Prepare ad hoc financial and cost analysis to support planning cycles, budget reviews, and executive asks
* Perform unit-economic analysis on new AI features to project cost-at-scale, enabling data-driven conversations with Product and Engineering teams regarding ROI and feature viability.

  

**Requirements**

  

**Must-have**

* 5-7+ years in FinOps, cloud cost management, or a closely related financial/technical analyst role
* Has built a cost attribution model from scratch not just maintained or updated one built by someone else
* Understanding of AI/LLM cost drivers: Deep familiarity with token-based pricing, model selection,, and the architectural levers that impact spend; ability to translate technical AI usage metrics into financial forecasts. Ability to
* AI-Enabled Automation: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., custom GPTs, Claude, or agentic workflows) to automate repetitive data analysis, reporting tasks, or internal workflows
* Track record of influencing engineering/architecture decisions on cost grounds
* Hands-on experience with cloud cost tools (AWS Cost Explorer required; CUDOS dashboards, CloudHealth, Cloudability, Vantage, or similar)
* AWS Compute Optimizer: Knowledge of how to use this service to identify right-sizing opportunities for EC2, Lambda, and EBS based on utilization metrics.
* AWS Budgets & Cost Anomaly Detection: Experience in setting up automated alerts and responding to usage spikes before they hit the monthly bill.
* Working SQL proficiency able to independently query and reconcile cost data, not just consume pre-built dashboards
* Experience pulling data via APIs from cloud/cost platforms
* High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling; comfort building executive-ready decks (PowerPoint/Slides)
* Demonstrated experience presenting cost/technical findings to non-technical executives or leadership, translating technical detail into business narrative
* Excellent organization, time management, and communication (written and verbal) skills

  

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience building financial models for variable-cost services (e.g., cloud API usage, token-based pricing) and translating technical usage patterns into business-level spend forecasts.
* Savings Plans and Reserved Instance cost attribution, so underlying resource usage changes are properly allocated to the teams that own the resources

97e7a7d5.title: Associate Principal - Architecture
97e7a7d5.description:
**Role description**

GenAI Solution Architect – Agentic Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Application Architect who has developed strong, hands-on expertise in Generative AI. The ideal candidate continues to write code, has deployed agentic and GenAI solutions in production, and can translate AI-led engineering strategy into executable delivery models for customer stakeholders across multiple time zones.

Key Responsibilities

### **1. GenAI Solution Architecture and SDLC Acceleration**

* Define the target-state architecture and adoption roadmap for an AI-led software development lifecycle, specifying where and how AI agents participate in planning, coding, review, testing, and deployment.

* Extend agentic workflows into engineering design and specification-driven development, using specifications and design documents as sources of truth and introducing AI-assisted architecture documentation and agent reviewers at design and code-review gates.

* Architect end-to-end GenAI solutions, including agentic developer workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and large language model applications for insurance workloads; scale successful patterns from pilot to production.

* Lead AI-accelerated architecture transformation across core and legacy modernization and new event-driven architecture implementations. Apply agents to code comprehension, documentation, migration, functional-equivalence test generation, and event schema and handler scaffolding.

* Design AI-enabled business workflows with human-in-the-loop controls, including document intake and extraction, confidence thresholds, exception routing, reviewer feedback loops, and end-to-end auditability.

* Coach offshore development squads in agent-assisted engineering and establish working practices, quality gates, and guardrails for AI-generated code.

* Lead GenAI engineers by setting technical direction, reviewing designs, and building the team’s agentic engineering capability.

* Define, measure, and report acceleration outcomes, including cycle time, throughput, quality, and adoption metrics; continuously improve the delivery blueprint based on evidence.

* Establish and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, responsible AI practices, and governance controls aligned with insurance data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

* Build evaluation and guardrail capabilities as first-class engineering components, including evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, hallucination and regression checks, output safeguards, and production monitoring.

### **2. Agentic Engineering and Tooling**

* Design multi-agent systems with clearly defined orchestrator, coder, reviewer, and tester roles, supported by task routing, state management, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

* Configure and govern enterprise GenAI developer tooling, including agentic coding tools, command-line coding agents, AI pair-programming solutions, MCP tool servers, custom commands, hooks, repository context and instruction files, agent SDKs, and orchestration frameworks.

* Design and deploy Model Context Protocol servers that securely expose customer tools, APIs, and data sources to AI agents, using appropriate tool-use and function-calling patterns.

* Select and integrate foundation models such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral through APIs or managed platforms including AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Google Vertex AI.

* Design model-tiering and routing strategies that balance capability, data residency, cost, latency, and workload volume.

* Deploy and operate GenAI workloads within enterprise cloud environments using private endpoints, network isolation, identity and access management, quota and rate-limit controls, regional-availability planning, model gateways, token budgeting, caching, and chargeback mechanisms.

### **3. Context Engineering, Business Ontology, and Domain Knowledge**

* Mine legacy code, documentation, wikis, and tickets to establish a customer knowledge fabric, with curation, versioning, and freshness practices that keep context accurate as systems and regulations evolve.

* Prepare data for AI by profiling and cleansing source data, normalizing and deduplicating content, correcting OCR noise, structuring unstructured information, and curating versioned datasets, including synthetic data where appropriate.

* Protect data throughout AI pipelines through de-identification, PII masking, redaction, lineage, and role-based access controls for prompts, retrieval corpora, evaluation datasets, and fine-tuning data.

* Establish metadata management and data-governance practices, including business glossaries, data catalogs, lineage, and traceability for ontologies, retrieval corpora, and datasets.

* Apply disciplined prompt and context engineering techniques, including few-shot examples and structured reasoning approaches, to improve solution reliability and consistency.

Required Experience and Capabilities

* Strong application architecture background combined with recent, hands-on GenAI engineering experience.

* Demonstrated experience deploying agentic or GenAI solutions into live, enterprise environments.

* Ability to remain hands-on with coding while providing architecture leadership and technical governance.

* Experience translating AI strategy into practical delivery models for distributed customer and engineering teams.

* Working knowledge of multi-agent design, RAG, LLM applications, MCP, model platforms, cloud deployment, responsible AI, evaluation, monitoring, and data governance.

* Experience operating within privacy-sensitive and regulated environments; insurance-domain experience is strongly relevant.

* Strong stakeholder communication, technical coaching, design-review, and cross-time-zone collaboration skills.

  
**Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Application Architecture, Architecture Patterns and Styles, Generative AI/Open AI/Vector DB, Python, RAGAS (Retrieval Augumented Generation Assessment) Framework  
**Good to Have Skills :** Architecture Governance, MLOPS

LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. * Extend agents upstream into engineering design: spec-driven development (specs and design documents as the source of truth agents implement against), AI-assisted architecture documentation, and agent reviewers in design and code-review gates.

* Lead architecture transformation accelerated by AI — core/legacy modernization and new event-driven architecture (EDA) implementations — using agents for code comprehension, documentation, migration, functional-equivalence test generation, and event schema/handler scaffolding.
* Design AI-enabled business workflows with humans in the loop: document intake and extraction, confidence thresholds and exception routing, reviewer feedback loops, and end-to-end auditability.

* Establish evaluation and guardrails as first-class engineering: evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, hallucination and regression checks, output guardrails, and production monitoring for GenAI systems.

2. Agentic Engineering & Tooling (hands-on)

* Design multi-agent systems with defined roles — orchestrator, coder, reviewer, tester agents — including task routing, state management, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Hands-on configuration and governance of GenAI developer tooling at enterprise scale: agentic coding tools — CLI-driven coding agents and AI pair-programming solutions that go well beyond autocomplete-style copilots — including tool-server (MCP) setup, custom commands, hooks, and repository context/instruction files, plus agent SDKs and orchestration frameworks.
* Design and deploy MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose the customer's tools, APIs, and data sources to AI agents; apply tool-use / function-calling patterns for LLM-driven agents.
* Select and integrate foundation models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Gemini) via APIs or managed platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI); design model-tiering and routing strategies — frontier reasoning models for complex work, fast lightweight models for high-volume steps, open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) where data residency requires — balancing capability, cost, and latency.

3. Context Engineering & Domain Knowledge Capture

* Design and operate context engineering frameworks: repository instruction and context files, system prompts, retrieval strategies, context-window budgeting, and memory patterns — so agents carry accurate project, codebase, and domain context.
* Context engineering for business ontology: model the customer's domain as formal ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs — entities, relationships, and business rules — so agents reason over structured domain semantics, not just retrieved text.
* Model business processes as state machines: explicit lifecycle and state-transition models that let agents know where a case stands and which actions are legal — and deterministic state-machine orchestration to govern non-deterministic agent workflows.
* Capture and codify insurance domain knowledge: work with SMEs to elicit product structures, underwriting and claims rules, processes, glossaries, and regulatory constraints, and convert them into machine-usable assets — knowledge bases, taxonomies, RAG corpora, and golden datasets that ground agent output.
* Apply prompt engineering rigor: few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, structured output design, prompt versioning, and evaluation against golden datasets.

Required Qualifications

* 12–14 years of proven experience in technology leadership / principal or application architect roles on enterprise-scale, distributed multi-tier systems.
* Strong architecture pedigree: n-tier, microservices, and event-driven architecture (EDA) design — including messaging/streaming platforms (Kafka or cloud-native equivalents) — enterprise integration, API design and management, and cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure, or GCP (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, containers, CI/CD).
* Deep expertise in at least one major enterprise stack (Java/Spring, .NET, Python, or Node.js) with breadth across others; working proficiency in Python for GenAI development.
* Demonstrable agentic GenAI delivery: at least one agent-assisted engineering or LLM-based solution taken into production or a serious enterprise pilot — able to walk through the architecture, trade-offs, and measured outcomes.
* Practical, current knowledge of multi-agent design, MCP, RAG variants (hybrid search with re-ranking, agentic RAG, RAG over code and structured data), embeddings/vector search, prompt and context engineering, evaluation harnesses and guardrails, and LLM limitations (hallucination, context-window constraints, cost/latency, data privacy).
* Experience leading technology-driven programs — POCs, innovation initiatives, and solution asset development — through to large-scale delivery.
* Experience practicing Design Thinking and Systems Thinking in real-world scenarios.
* Outstanding client-facing communication: proven experience engaging customer stakeholders on requirements and delivery, and explaining complex technology in an easy-to-understand way.
