c79c2b26.title: Software Solution Architect II
c79c2b26.description:
**Role description**

***Who we are:***

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

**Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced **AI Solution / Enterprise Architect** to lead the architectural transformation of enterprise software delivery through **AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI**. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in **Solution/Enterprise Architecture**, hands-on experience with **GenAI and AI agents**, and a proven background in **AI-led SDLC transformation and full-stack modernization**.

This role will define the technical foundation for an AI-native operating model, identify and resolve architectural gaps across integration, orchestration, tooling, security, and governance, and guide Solution Architects toward independent, AI-native architectural decision-making.

  

**The Opportunity:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architectural dimension of AI-led SDLC transformation across enterprise engagements.
* Identify and resolve architecture gaps across integration, orchestration, AI tooling, APIs, cloud platforms, security, and DevOps.
* Design the technical foundation required to support Agentic AI and AI-native delivery models.
* Review and validate AI-generated architecture, solution designs, code, and technical outputs.
* Define and govern Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), AI security guardrails, access-control boundaries, and compliance standards.
* Develop and maintain a Model Usage Matrix, mapping AI agent tasks to appropriate LLMs based on capability, cost, performance, security, and compliance.
* Design data models, ontologies, and machine-readable constraint schemas to govern AI agent behavior.
* Provide architectural leadership and coach Solution Architects in AI-native architecture, NFR design, security, and guardrail implementation.
* Partner with AI Technical Project Managers, AI Engineers, engineering teams, QA, and DevOps throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI/GenAI engineering practices and Agentic AI solutions.
* Lead modernization initiatives spanning architecture, application development, cloud, QA, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and observability.
  

**What you need:**  
**Required Skills:**

* 8+ years of strong Solution Architecture / Enterprise Architecture experience, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level architecture decisions.
* 2+ years of hands-on AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI experience, including practical implementation of AI-driven solutions.
* Hands-on experience with AI-led SDLC transformation, including AI-assisted architecture, development, testing, and engineering workflows.
* Experience with GenAI coding assistants and AI development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.
* Hands-on exposure to Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, API/integration architecture, cloud, microservices, DevOps/DevSecOps, and security.
* Strong full-stack modernization background with proficiency in Java, Python, or equivalent enterprise technology stacks.
* Experience defining NFRs, AI security guardrails, access controls, governance standards, and responsible AI boundaries.
* Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and observability.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, ontology design, and machine-readable constraint schemas.
* Proven ability to lead architects, influence engineering teams, and drive enterprise-wide AI adoption.
  

**Desired Skills:**

* Experience within BFSI or Healthcare domains.

* Experience evaluating and selecting LLMs based on capability, cost, security, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

* Exposure to enterprise-scale AI governance and Responsible AI practices.

* Experience modernizing large-scale legacy or full-stack applications using cloud-native and AI-enabled engineering approaches.

* Ability to work across architecture, software engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and AI engineering rather than operating in a design-only architecture role.

**Qualification:**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  

***What we believe****:*

*We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.*

***Humility:***

*We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.*

  

***Humanity:***

*Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.*

  

***Integrity:***

*We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.*

  

***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement***

*UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.*

  

*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*

*UST* *reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance.*

* *To support and promote the values of UST.*

* *Comply with all Company policies and procedures*

 **Skills**

Agentic AI, Data Modeling, Generative AI

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

354f7d55.title: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Manager Delivery -AI Solutions/ Platform (Gen AI / LLM, RAG)
354f7d55.description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Manager Delivery - AI Solutions / Platform(Gen AI / LLM, RAG, Agentic AI)
  
  
Experience: 12+Years
  
  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
  
  
Shift: 12:00 PM-9.30 PM
  
  
Location: Bangalore/Pune
  
  
Position ID: J1026-0360
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Manager - Delivery to lead engineering delivery for enterprise AI solutions and reusable AI platform capabilities. The role combines strong technical leadership with delivery and people management. The candidate will guide developers, AI engineers, QA and DevOps engineers; challenge architecture and design decisions; drive engineering quality, security, scalability and production readiness; and ensure predictable delivery of business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong application engineering foundation in Java and/or Python, APIs, microservices and cloud-native platforms, together with practical experience delivering Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and agentic AI patterns. The role does not require an AI research background; the emphasis is enterprise AI application engineering and technical delivery leadership.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Technical & Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead end-to-end technical delivery of enterprise AI solutions, GenAI applications and reusable AI platform capabilities from design through production.
* Provide technical direction and review solution architecture, detailed design, APIs, integration patterns, code quality, performance, scalability and security.
* Guide implementation of LLM-based solutions including RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, orchestration, prompt engineering and enterprise integrations.
* Own sprint and release planning, estimation, resource allocation, technical dependencies, risks, quality and delivery commitments.
* Drive production readiness, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, performance optimization and continuous improvement of AI services and platforms.

Team Engagement & People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor and engage cross-functional teams comprising AI/application developers, technical leads, QA and DevOps engineers.
* Build a strong engineering culture focused on collaboration, ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular team connect sessions, 1:1s and feedback discussions; identify engagement risks, impediments and actions to improve team effectiveness.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, succession planning and targeted upskilling in AI engineering and modern development practices.
* Identify skill gaps and create technical learning plans, communities of practice and opportunities for team members to contribute to reusable AI assets.

Operations & Engineering Management
  
  

* Own delivery operations for the technical organization, with accountability for revenue, gross margin, net margin, cost, utilization and overall delivery health.
* Track actuals versus plan for revenue, gross margin and net margin; identify variances early and drive corrective actions with delivery and leadership teams.
* Prepare revenue and resource forecasts, including capacity planning, demand pipeline, ramp-up/ramp-down plans, hiring needs and allocation of technical resources across engagements.
* Monitor team utilization and bench levels, balancing billable delivery, platform investments, production support, technical debt and capability development.
* Drive productivity and engineering efficiency through automation, AI-enabled development, reuse of platform capabilities and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Establish and review operational KPIs covering revenue attainment, margin performance, utilization, productivity, delivery predictability, quality, automation, incidents and customer commitments.
* Lead operational governance including monthly/quarterly business reviews, financial reviews, resource reviews, risk and dependency reviews, and action tracking.
* Partner with account, finance, sales and delivery leadership on forecasting, financial planning, staffing decisions, pricing inputs and opportunities to improve delivery economics.

AI Engineering & Quality
  
  

* Establish AI quality and reliability practices covering evaluation, grounding, hallucination reduction, guardrails, latency, cost, monitoring and human-in-the-loop controls where appropriate.
* Promote AI-enabled software development practices using coding assistants/agents for development, testing, code review and engineering productivity, with appropriate governance.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, delivery status and operational performance clearly to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must to Have Skills:
  
  
12+ years of software engineering experience with significant technical leadership and delivery management responsibility.
  
  

* Recent practical experience delivering enterprise GenAI/AI applications or platforms.
* Strong understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search/vector databases and model evaluation.
* Understanding of agentic AI concepts including agents, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, state/memory and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Strong backend engineering experience in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python/FastAPI, with REST APIs, microservices and distributed application architecture.
* Experience designing or managing reusable platform services and enterprise integrations rather than only standalone AI proofs of concept.
* Cloud-native engineering experience on Azure, AWS or GCP, with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Strong DevOps engineering knowledge including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, release management and environment management.
* Understanding of LLMOps/MLOps practices including prompt/model configuration versioning, evaluation, monitoring, observability and controlled deployment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security including authentication/authorization, secrets management, data privacy, secure API integration and responsible AI controls.
* Proven experience managing developers, QA and DevOps engineers and driving engineering standards, technical reviews and production readiness.
* Strong Agile delivery, estimation, planning, risk/dependency management and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience using or enabling AI-assisted development tools responsibly across the software development lifecycle.

Good to have skills-
  
  

* NET; LangChain; LangGraph; Spring AI; Semantic Kernel; MCP; Kubernetes/OpenShift; Azure/AWS/GCP; LLMOps/MLOps; AI Evaluation & Observability; Guardrails; Vector Databases & Embeddings; DevOps/CI-CD; Healthcare domain exposure

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

cb3acfef.title: Engagement Manager - Advance Industries
cb3acfef.description:
Job ID: 113021

* Bengaluru
* Chennai
* New Delhi
* Gurugram
* Kolkata
* Mumbai

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

You will typically lead a team of 3 – 5 consultants to help clients achieve new performance highs.

You will lead the day-to-day execution of a client project while guiding and developing individual team members. You’ll work directly with clients – usually on site – and you’ll take ownership of the overall project and its end products.

You will make an important contribution to the analysis, design, and implementation of business performance approaches, developing tailor-made solutions and working closely with clients to ensure positive impact and sustainable results.

You will have the opportunity to build on your proven leadership skills and leverage your interest in inspiring others, building strong relationships, and creating a true followership. In a collaborative team setting, you'll work closely with others but also autonomously with little direction. Your superior analytical, quantitative and conceptual thinking skills and strong interpersonal and communication skills will ensure successful client projects and team performance.

Client project work typically includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing recommendations for presentation to client management. From there, you will implement those recommendations with client team members.

You’ll also gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm. Consultants receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues and senior leaders on their teams.

You’ll be based in one of our offices in India and will work in teams and directly with our clients.

You are joining a firm that will challenge you and invest heavily in your professional development. You will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world – across the private, public, and social sectors – solve some of their most difficult problems.

**YOUR GROWTH**
---------------

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

* **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* **Global community:** With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* **World-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree with consistent outstanding academic record; MBA preferred
* 6+ years of business management or consulting experience
* Proven record of high performance and substantial achievements in your past positions
* Deep expertise in industries such as Automotive, Industrial B2B, Machinery, Semiconductors, Electronics etc.
* Solid functional knowledge, including but not limited to strategy, business development, manufacturing, supply chain, product development, project management, marketing and sales, etc.
* Outstanding records of academic and managerial or professional achievement
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated leadership ability in a team environment Initiative taker, eager to break new ground, create opportunities for others
* Willingness to take personal risks - as seen through leadership roles - in work environment and extracurricular activities
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
* Skills to communicate complex ideas effectively

Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues.

Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

6707db5e.title: Manager, Fund Solutions (Project) Restructuring
6707db5e.description:
This position will involve assisting in the delivery of the Firm’s Fund Solutions and Restructuring services based in Mumbai and/or Delhi. Typical assignments will include participating in fund and restructuring advisory, asset wind down support and asset management projects.
  
  
Our Fund Solutions and Restructuring professionals serve as financial advisors to fund managers, companies, financial sponsors, lenders, creditors and other interested parties in special and distressed situations across virtually every industry and every situation throughout the business life cycle.
  
  
As a VP/Manager, Fund Solutions, you will be responsible for supporting complex fund liquidation and wind-down engagements across jurisdictions. This role will be based in India and will collaborate closely with global teams in the U.S., Europe, and APAC to manage, lead and deliver high-quality solutions to asset managers, fund administrators, and institutional investors navigating end-of-life fund scenarios. In addition to training junior staff members, the successful candidate will work on a range of assignments including supporting the global teams including management of fund operations (mainly in End Of Fund Life situations for global funds) such as accounting, taxation, legal and investor relations. You will also work on asset management, financial analysis, NAV workings and exit related strategies for such funds. The candidate will support the growth of the Fund Solutions and Restructuring business in the Asia & EMEA region.
  
  
**Navigating Responsibilities**

* Coordinating and working with multiple teams across Kroll to ensure deadlines are met and proactively communicate progress/updates with external stakeholders.
* Review the work of the junior team members, coordinate and manage workflow amongst the team and ensure timely delivery of the projects.
* Understanding public and private databases like Pitchbook, Preqin and Capital IQ is a plus.
* Review fund documentation (LPAs, IMs, governing documents) to identify constraints and obligations.
* Draft and present liquidation strategy memos, investor updates, and board-level communications.
* Oversee the efficient and timely progression of a portfolio of Fund Solutions and Restructuring projects.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Understanding of valuation concepts
* Strong hold on accounting and financial concepts.
* Prior exposures to fund structures, such as master/feeder, management fee, carry etc. is preferred.
* Ability to interpret and apply foreign rules, regulations and laws is a plus. Ability to work in regulated environments like SEC, Cayman, Mauritius etc.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with fund managers, financial sponsors, creditors, asset agents and solicitors.

**Essential Traits**

* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to develop and drive relationships with individuals from all industries.
* Ability to master new tasks quickly whilst showing strong attention to detail.
* Ability to lead a team consisting of Senior Associates and Analysts.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and work on multiple assignments
* Ability to manage rapidly changing assignments and work well under pressure.
* Strong team player and work in a team environment, across multiple mandates.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to assess and manage risk, deal with ambiguity and understand the commercial drivers of the outcomes of our work
* Relevant degree, achieving 2:1 or equivalent.
* At least 6 to 7 years’ relevant experience.
* A relevant accounting or investment qualification is preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

**About Kroll**
Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions - Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
  
  
Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit.
  
  
To be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.

73fffee1.title: Delivery Manager I
73fffee1.description:
**Role description**

POSITION SUMMARY We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Program Manager, Program Management Office (PMO) to manage and lead our program management function. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build the PMO as a one-person office initially, with potential to scale as our organization grows. A cross-functional launch coordinator sitting between Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Training. They run the program-management process for product launches — requirements gathering, status tracking, roadblock reporting, and keeping project plans current — but they do not own any team's deliverables and do not make the call on how to recover a slipping timeline, that decision stays with the sponsors. In this role, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional leaders to drive alignment, ensure delivery discipline, and bring visibility to key initiatives across our UCaaS and CCaaS portfolio. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Establish the PMO function, defining lightweight processes and governance tailored to an agile SaaS delivery model. Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to plan, track, and report on key initiatives across UCaaS and CCaaS product lines. Develop and maintain dashboards, status reporting, and program metrics to ensure visibility for leadership. Facilitate cross-team alignment, identifying and resolving delivery risks and dependencies. Support quarterly and monthly planning cadences, ensuring priorities and resourcing are aligned. Drive consistency in program execution without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy. Serve as the single point of contact for program and portfolio reporting, scaling the function over time as needed. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree or PMP certification a plus). 15+ years of experience with 5+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 3 years in a SaaS or cloud-based technology company. SDLC understanding with a solid technical background — essential, not nice-to-have SaaS environment experience — essential Demonstrated ability to be highly organized, detail-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities simultaneously. Familiarity with agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) and experience adapting governance to agile environments. Self-starter comfortable operating as a one-person PMO, building structure from the ground up. Proficiency with program tracking tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar). Available to overlap until 1:00 PM Eastern Free to pick their own preferred project management tool to some degree Experience managing programs in UCaaS, CCaaS, or related communications technology preferred.

 **Skills**

CCaaS, Cloud Infrastructure, Stakeholder Management, Agile

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

e6bb778f.title: Program Manager II, ShipTech, ShipTech
e6bb778f.description:
**Description**
ShipTech is the connective tissue, which connects Transportation Service Providers, First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to facilitate the shipping of billions of packages each year. Due to criticality of the ShipTech systems, world-wide (WW) Amazon business organizations work with ShipTech every year to deliver their programs for network expansion, operational efficiency improvement, new feature delivery to enhance customer/operator experience, compliance asks, etc. WW requestors submit intakes to deliver: (1) on-boarding new shippers, carriers, and services to the shipping network, (2) facilitating package movement and tracking in Amazon and third-party (3P) network, (3) changes in carrier artifacts like a label and manifest, (4) carrier configurations like routing codes, account ids, and (5) custom tech-builds for meeting business specific asks delivered by ShipTech every year.
  
  
We are looking for a Program Manager to be a part of our multi-year effort to execute the vision and support the operational execution for the Global Program team. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Customer Fulfillment, Transportation & Logistics, and Operational Finance, within WW Operations. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business, Operations, Tech, and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have successfully led programs in the operations excellence or supply chain analytics space. They have strong analytical skills and expertise in excel. They will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Program Manager you will be responsible for driving cross-functional product design platform capabilities alignment among stakeholders. You will work closely with Product Management and Technology teams as well as various Business Operations and Carrier launch teams to intake new use cases by collecting requirements, scoping, prioritizing and than working with development teams to implement and deploy tech changes . Your role is critical in executing our program and project initiatives, while providing great internal customer support and driving consistency, help us continue to support our initiatives, and identify process improvement opportunities.
  
  
Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. This candidate must have crisp communication skills, and have experience communicating project status and updates across a global audience. We are looking for someone who is detail-driven, and has excellent problem solving and communication abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs and a high bias for action are important for this role.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The successful candidate will have very strong analytical skills and expertise in excel. She/he will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. She/he will be experienced at working with large data sets and managing multiple competing priorities. She/he will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, and be a passionate advocate of the team and processes to stakeholders. She/he will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a team of program managers who work across 20+ platform tech teams. Our stakeholders are transportation teams across regions. We contribute to several large-scale high-visibility programs each year such as network expansion projects like market place launches and carrier launches, and new feature build outs to provide enhanced customer experience or better operational efficiencies. We also support several compliance programs across our worldwide stakeholders. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to work with with global business customers and our engineering teams to support intake requests related to new carrier on-boarding and ship method integrations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales / Furniture Sales**

**Location:**
Alankaram Showroom, Bengaluru

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an
**Interior Designer with strong client-facing skills**
to join the Pre-Sales team at our Bengaluru showroom.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys understanding spaces, interacting with clients, recommending furniture and material solutions, and converting design conversations into successful orders.

Unlike a conventional retail-sales role, this position requires a strong understanding of
**interior design, furniture proportions, materials, finishes, space planning and aesthetics**
. You will work closely with homeowners, architects and interior designers to help them select and customise furniture suited to their spaces.

The role offers an opportunity to combine
**design knowledge with commercial and client-management skills**
, with a clear career path towards
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend to clients visiting the Bengaluru showroom and understand their requirements, lifestyle, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend appropriate furniture, materials, finishes, fabrics, colours and configurations.
* Help clients visualise how furniture will work within their interiors in terms of
  **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language**
  .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
  **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility**
  .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.

What We Are Looking For

**Education**

Bachelor's / Diploma in:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.

**Experience**

Ideally
**3–7 years of experience**
in one or more of the following:

* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials

Previous sales experience is useful but
**not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client-facing ability and commercial orientation**
.

Essential Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of
  **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences

Particularly Important for This Role

We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:

**“What kind of home are you creating?”**

to

**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”**

and eventually to:

**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”**

The candidate therefore needs to be
**a designer first, but commercially minded**
.

Performance Indicators

* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation-to-order conversion %
* Follow-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business

c2d9b913.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior FP&A Solutions Consultant based in India.**
In this role, you will combine financial planning expertise, consulting skills, and technology to help organizations transform their budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes. You will work closely with project managers and client finance teams to design intuitive, scalable financial models and reporting solutions that support better business decisions. From financial planning templates to dashboards and management reports, your work will help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and financial performance. You will act as a trusted advisor, translating complex financial requirements into practical, user-friendly solutions. You will also guide clients through implementation, training, and adoption while collaborating with internal teams to continuously improve customer outcomes. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to make a meaningful impact in a growing software environment at the intersection of finance, consulting, and technology.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Design, configure, and implement financial models, planning templates, dashboards, and reports tailored to clients' business requirements and financial processes.
* Collaborate with client finance teams and key stakeholders to understand business models, identify challenges, and translate financial planning needs into scalable, effective solutions.
* Support core financial planning and analysis processes, including budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, cost allocations, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Develop intuitive, well-structured financial models and reporting solutions that improve data visibility, simplify workflows, and support informed decision-making.
* Work closely with project managers to coordinate implementation activities, manage timelines and deliverables, and maintain alignment with client expectations.
* Provide guidance and training to finance teams, helping users adopt new tools, understand best practices, and maximize the value of implemented solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting quality, and planning efficiency.
* Collaborate with internal Product, Customer Success, and Sales teams to share client feedback, address challenges, and improve the overall customer experience.
* Manage multiple client engagements and priorities while maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and service delivery.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending practical enhancements to financial models, implementation methods, and customer-facing solutions.

**Requirements**

* At least 5 years of professional experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), financial consulting, or financial software implementation.
* Strong understanding of financial planning and management processes, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial reporting, and performance monitoring.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated expertise in financial modeling, including structuring financial data, developing reliable models, and presenting insights clearly.
* Ability to translate complex financial requirements into intuitive, scalable models, templates, dashboards, and reporting solutions that encourage user adoption.
* Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand operational needs, and deliver tailored financial solutions.
* Familiarity with financial management systems and FP&A platforms such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Adaptive Planning, Planful, or comparable tools is an advantage.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage with senior finance leaders and explain financial concepts and technical solutions clearly.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying business needs and recommending improvements beyond the initial requirements.
* Proven project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and balance competing priorities in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, usability, and the quality of financial deliverables.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, clients, and other stakeholders.
* A genuine interest in combining finance, consulting, and technology to improve financial planning processes and business outcomes.
* Professional qualifications such as CPA, CFA, or PMP are considered an advantage but are not mandatory.

**Benefits**

* 100% remote work: Work remotely from India, offering flexibility in your working environment.
* Full-time employment: Join a growing software business focused on modernizing financial planning and analysis.
* Meaningful client impact: Help finance teams improve budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making through practical technology solutions.
* Cross-functional exposure: Collaborate with project managers, product specialists, customer success professionals, sales teams, and finance leaders.
* Professional development: Strengthen your expertise across financial modeling, FP&A consulting, software implementation, and technology-enabled finance transformation.
* Client-facing experience: Build trusted relationships with customers and develop your consulting, stakeholder management, and advisory skills.
* Ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for delivering solutions from requirements gathering through implementation, training, and adoption.
* Innovation-focused environment: Contribute to improving financial planning workflows through modern software, intuitive modeling, and scalable reporting solutions.
* Career growth opportunities: Expand your professional capabilities in a growing SaaS environment at the intersection of finance and technology.

36fcf11f.title: Pre-Sales Executive - Designer
36fcf11f.description:
**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales / Furniture Sales**

**Location:**
Alankaram Showroom, Hyderabad

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an
**Interior Designer with strong client-facing skills**
to join the Pre-Sales team at our Hyderabad showroom.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys understanding spaces, interacting with clients, recommending furniture and material solutions, and converting design conversations into successful orders.

Unlike a conventional retail-sales role, this position requires a strong understanding of
**interior design, furniture proportions, materials, finishes, space planning and aesthetics**
. You will work closely with homeowners, architects and interior designers to help them select and customise furniture suited to their spaces.

The role offers an opportunity to combine
**design knowledge with commercial and client-management skills**
, with a clear career path towards
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend to clients visiting the Bengaluru showroom and understand their requirements, lifestyle, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend appropriate furniture, materials, finishes, fabrics, colours and configurations.
* Help clients visualise how furniture will work within their interiors in terms of
  **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language**
  .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
  **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility**
  .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.

What We Are Looking For

**Education**

Bachelor's / Diploma in:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.

**Experience**

Ideally
**3–7 years of experience**
in one or more of the following:

* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials

Previous sales experience is useful but
**not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client-facing ability and commercial orientation**
.

Essential Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of
  **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences

Particularly Important for This Role

We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:

**“What kind of home are you creating?”**

to

**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”**

and eventually to:

**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”**

The candidate therefore needs to be
**a designer first, but commercially minded**
.

Performance Indicators

* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation-to-order conversion %
* Follow-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business

Career Growth

A strong candidate should be able to progress through:

**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales**

→
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer**

→
**Assistant Sales Manager**

→
**Sales Manager / Showroom Manager**

→
**Zonal Sales Manager**

→
**Regional Sales Manager**

**You should have:**

* Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
* 3+ years relevant experience
* Strong design and aesthetic understanding
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confidence dealing with premium clients
* Ability to understand drawings and space plans
* Strong ownership and follow-up skills
* A commercial mindset and willingness to work towards sales goals

**Why join Alankaram?**

Build expertise in premium furniture and client advisory while developing a career beyond conventional interior-design roles.

Strong performers can grow into
**Senior Pre-Sales, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager roles**
.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role:**
Full-time, showroom-based

02fba33e.title: Senior Solution Consultant
02fba33e.description:
**About Us:**

Founded in 2002 in Sydney, with offices in India and a presence across the Americas and Europe, Prospecta is a leading data management software company. Our flagship platform, Master Data Online (MDO), enables accurate, compliant, and relevant master data for asset-intensive industries including Energy, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Mining, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing.

We pride ourselves on agility, collaboration, and innovation delivering real value to customers while fostering a diverse, growth-driven culture that encourages learning, embraces challenges, and celebrates success.

**About the Job:**

**Position:**
Senior Solution Consultant

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Role Summary:**
Prospecta is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join our Master Data Online (MDO) practice, supporting the design and delivery of enterprise data governance solutions on SAP. The successful candidate will bring deep SAP ERP experience, a strong background in data governance and master data management (MDG or equivalent), and hands-on exposure to Asset and Material data domains. This is a client-facing role spanning requirement gathering, governance design, and close collaboration with technical build teams to deliver configured and custom solutions.

**Must Have:**

* 10+ years of overall experience working with SAP ERP systems.
* Minimum of 2 data governance projects involving SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) or related master data management products.
* Demonstrated experience implementing data governance projects for SAP, including business rule definition, workflow design, and data quality frameworks.
* Strong functional experience in the Asset domain (e.g., SAP Plant Maintenance) and/or Material domain (e.g., Material Master, MRP, Purchasing).
* Proven experience leading or actively participating in requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating with technical/build teams on custom development, including RFCs, function modules, or other SAP enhancements supporting governance workflows.
* Solid understanding of master data lifecycle management, data classification, and data quality validation principles.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical audiences.

**Good to Have:**

* Familiarity with ISO 14224 or other asset/equipment classification standards.
* Experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) transactions and master data objects (e.g., IE03, IL03, QS41, CT04, CL02).
* Exposure to Master Data Online (MDO) or comparable master data governance platforms.
* Background in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Mining, or Utilities.
* Prior consulting experience, with a track record of client-facing solution delivery.
* Experience in data analytics, data quality management, or data transformation.
* Good knowledge of scripting languages — Python, R, or SQL.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and support requirement gathering workshops with client stakeholders to define business rules, data standards, and governance workflows for master data (Asset and/or Material domains).
* Translate business requirements into functional designs for data governance processes, validation rules, and approval workflows within MDO.
* Partner with Build teams to define technical requirements and support the development of custom RFCs, function modules, and enhancements needed to operationalize governance rules in SAP.
* Design and validate data quality rules, classification structures, and master data models aligned to industry standards and client-specific requirements.
* Support configuration and testing of governance workflows, ensuring alignment between business rules and system behavior.
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle, from design through go-live and stabilization.
* Contribute to solution documentation, functional specifications, and test scripts to support project delivery and knowledge transfer.
* Provide subject matter guidance on SAP master data structures, data governance best practices, and related tools and processes.
* Participate in the sales cycle by supporting product demonstrations and contributing to the preparation of Statements of Work (SOW) for prospective clients.

**Growth Path:**

At Prospecta, your career journey is one of growth and opportunity, whether you're looking to kickstart your career or accelerate your professional development in a dynamic, collaborative environment. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact data governance and digital transformation projects for global clients, gaining hands-on exposure to leading master data management technologies, practices, and asset and master data solutions. As you demonstrate your capabilities and deliver results, you’ll have opportunities to advance into roles such as Project Manager or explore other cross-functional career paths. We’re committed to supporting your growth by providing the tools, guidance, experience, and opportunities you need to continuously strengthen your skills and take your career to the next level.

Benefits:

* Competitive salary;
* Comprehensive health insurance:
* Generous paid time off;
* Flexible hybrid working model
* Ongoing learning & career development;
* Onsite work opportunities; and
* Annual company events and workshops.

If you’re ready to join an innovative, forward-thinking organization and work alongside inspiring leaders like Julian Blackley, Romit Mukerji, and Ritu Jakhar we’d love to hear from you.

Join Prospecta and take the first step toward an exciting, impactful, and rewarding career!

d9e3934a.title: Sr IT Architect I-SAP Integration
d9e3934a.description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Job Title:** Senior Solution Architect I-SAP Integration

**Department:** SAP Development & Integration, SAP & Ecosystems, Enterprise IT & Quality

**Location: Global Business Solutions, Bangalore**

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Senior Solution Architect I-SAP Integration, you will shape how SAP connects with the rest of Novo’s global landscape. You will own the SAP-centric integration architecture and roadmap and set the API-led and event-driven patterns teams build on. Your decisions will make integrations secure, reusable and compliant, so the processes behind our global operations run reliably today and scale for tomorrow.

  

**What you’ll bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Typically 10+ years in enterprise integration, including substantial experience as an integration or solution architect in complex global landscapes.
* Deep architecture and hands-on knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, especially Cloud Integration (CPI): iFlows, adapters, mappings, Groovy scripting, exception handling and monitoring.
* Strong experience with SAP BTP subaccounts, entitlements, destinations and connectivity, and proven SAP Cloud Connector expertise, including whitelisting, certificates, principal propagation and high availability.
* Experience with SAP API Management and API lifecycle governance, plus practical event-driven experience with SAP Advanced Event Mesh or a comparable event broker.
* Strong knowledge of SAP Advanced Event Mesh administration and governance, including broker landscape and service lifecycle management, capacity planning, dynamic message routing, event modelling, access management, event discovery and publishing, monitoring, tracing and operational insights.
* Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA/ECC and SAP cloud applications with non-SAP systems using IDoc, RFC, SOAP, REST, OData, SFTP, AS2, XML, JSON and XSLT.
* Solid integration security knowledge, including mutual TLS, OAuth 2.0, SAML, secrets management and data protection.
* Proven technical leadership, architecture governance and mentoring across distributed internal and partner teams, and the ability to build support without relying on formal authority.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience leading SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite migration (highly desirable).
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Solution Advisory Methodology, Clean Core guidance, Business Accelerator Hub, Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Edge Integration Cell or Cloud ALM.
* Regulated-industry experience, including GxP validation, audit evidence and data integrity.
* A master’s degree or SAP Integration Suite/BTP, TOGAF, cloud or security certification. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  

**What you’ll do**

As design authority for significant SAP integrations, you will make independent architecture decisions within enterprise standards and follow them through from early advisory to go-live and adoption. You will:

* Own and evolve the SAP-centric integration target state and roadmap in line with enterprise strategy and SAP Clean Core principles.
* Lead architecture for SAP-to-SAP, SAP-to-non-SAP, cloud and hybrid scenarios, defining reusable API, messaging, B2B and event-driven patterns that replace isolated point-to-point connections.
* Architect secure hybrid connectivity and event-driven designs with SAP Cloud Connector and SAP Advanced Event Mesh, building in security, resilience, observability and GxP compliance from the start.
* Define and govern the SAP Advanced Event Mesh landscape, including broker provisioning principles, service sizing and capacity planning, dynamic message-routing patterns, user and group access models, and lifecycle standards.
* Own the architectural approach for event modelling, event discovery and publishing, monitoring, tracing and operational insights, working with platform and operations teams to ensure that event-driven solutions are secure, observable, scalable and ready to run.
* Make sure every solution is ready to run, with monitoring, runbooks, clear ownership and incident-response readiness.
* Mentor architects and engineers, build reference implementations and evaluate new SAP BTP capabilities against clear business value.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join SAP Development & Integration, part of SAP & Ecosystems in Enterprise IT. The team designs, builds and operates enterprise-scale SAP development and integration – from ABAP to SAP BTP Integration Suite, APIs and Event Mesh – connecting business processes, applications and data across a global landscape.

Your closest partners include Enterprise Architecture, Design Authority and the Integration Architecture committee, SAP platform and BTP teams, Product Owners, and IT Security, Quality, Validation and Compliance. You will also work with network, infrastructure and operations teams, and externally with SAP, implementation partners and B2B partners. Representing SAP Integration Architecture in global forums, you will help teams across regions align on one clear integration direction.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to own architecture decisions and influence platform roadmaps, technology investments and supplier designs. Without direct people management, your influence comes from expertise, clarity and the quality of your recommendations.

You will keep pace with SAP BTP and integration evolution and turn what you learn into standards others use. You will be part of a culture that values honest feedback, constructive challenge and quality, where standards are calibrated to the situation and patient safety is never compromised.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to set the integration direction that connects Novo’s global SAP landscape, apply today

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

e8775d50.title: Enterprise Technology Architect
e8775d50.description:
**Project Role :** Enterprise Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Architect complex end-to-end IT solutions across the enterprise. Apply the latest technology and industry expertise to create better products and experiences.
  
**Must have skills :** Accenture Delivery Architectures (ADA)  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As an Enterprise Technology Architect, a typical day involves designing and overseeing comprehensive information technology solutions that span the entire organization. This role requires envisioning and structuring complex systems to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. The position demands collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure that technology strategies align with business goals, while continuously exploring innovative approaches to improve products and services across the enterprise.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of architectural frameworks that support scalable and sustainable technology solutions.
* Facilitate cross-functional communication to ensure alignment of technology initiatives with organizational objectives.

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Accenture Delivery Architectures (ADA).
* Strong expertise in designing enterprise-wide technology architectures that integrate diverse systems and platforms.
* Ability to analyze complex business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Experience in guiding teams through architectural best practices and governance processes.
* Skilled in evaluating emerging technologies and recommending their adoption to enhance enterprise capabilities.

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Accenture Delivery Architectures (ADA).
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

87ce1d9c.description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to join the MITO Domain Adaptation stream. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering end-to-end Service Assurance solutions for global customers, from pre-sales through solution design, implementation, customer acceptance, and operational handover. You will lead solution architecture, requirement analysis, system integration, and technical delivery while ensuring high-quality implementations aligned with customer requirements and industry best practices.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design end-to-end solution architectures and technical blueprints aligned with business and customer needs.
* Gather and analyze customer requirements, perform feasibility assessments, and develop solution proposals.
* Lead solution design, implementation, deployment, and customer acceptance activities.
* Define scalable, secure, reusable, and event-driven integration architectures across enterprise applications, OSS/BSS, IT infrastructure, cloud, and virtualized environments.
* Establish integration standards, frameworks, reusable components, and best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure compliance with security, governance, performance, and reliability standards.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Manage one or more MITO delivery projects, ensuring delivery within scope, quality, and timelines.
* Collaborate with customers, Solution Architects, MSIT & ADM, MA/CU organizations, SDAP, Managed Services delivery teams, and customer O&M teams.
* Provide technical leadership, stakeholder management, solution consulting, effort estimation, roadmap planning, and delivery governance.
* Drive automation, operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and service excellence.

* Strong expertise in Solution Architecture, System Design, Enterprise Integration, and IT Service Assurance solutions.
* Experience delivering OSS/BSS System Integration and Managed Services projects.
* Strong knowledge of Fault Management, Performance Management, Reporting, Monitoring, and Automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms including SNMP, Zabbix, ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, OpenTelemetry (OTEL), and Jasper Reports.
* Experience with integration technologies including REST APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Kafka, and RabbitMQ.

* Proficiency in Python, Shell, Perl, JavaScript, XML, and database technologies.
* Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership capabilities.

d2d57d80.title: Solution/Skills Architect (SA)
d2d57d80.description:
**The Opportunity**
Avantor is looking for a Solution/Skills Architect (SA) is a strong technical/functional advisor who works closely with Skills Builder to define data analytics models, as well as the Decision Data Model in support of the skills workbench to enhance the Decision Intelligent skills catalog.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP functional/technical configurations, BI reporting, and data integration, with the ability to collaborate across architecture, development, and customer-facing teams. This role requires proficiency in
**Prompt Engineering**
for AI-assisted development, along with strong
**API integration knowledge**
and database experience.
  
  
**Major Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Translate business and functional requirements into technical specification documents.
* Architect skills with all features and functions, ensuring all are designed and developed per business requirements.
* Prepare skill blueprints and detailed documentation for each associated skill.
* Responsible for testing and overall QA of the solution from a functional standpoint.
* Collaborate with Decision Architect and Skill Builders to aid development and testing of Decision Data Models and applications.
* Run and support meetings and workshops with prospects and customers, ranging from early discovery sessions to detailed final presentations.
* Ensure operational controls are maintained and perform operating control self-assessments as required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of AERA functional/technical or solutions architecture experience in a team-based environment.
* 2+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Experience with developing Dashboards and Reports using different BI tools.
* Proficient with functional and technical configurations around SAP ECC 6.0 or SCM 5.x or 7.x.
* Strong and hands-on knowledge of key integration points between multiple systems such as SAP ECC, SAP APO, SAP BW, SAP IBP, HANA, Reporting, etc.
* Strong team player, capable of working collaboratively within and across internal and customer teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Prompt Engineering for AI-assisted development workflows and automation.
* Strong API integration and consumption knowledge (RESTful/Web APIs) for solution design and connectivity.
* Ability to convert business needs into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced Agile delivery environment.
* Strong communication skills with business users, QA teams, developers, and customer-facing teams.
* Strong documentation skills for skill blueprints, design specs, test results, and support procedures.
* Good understanding of software development lifecycle, change control procedures, and production support best practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

**Added Advantage / Preferred Skills**

* Working knowledge of function modules, structures, tables, BAPIs, and BADIs.
* Knowledge of data science methods and tools.
* Knowledge and experience working with In-Memory, MPP, column-oriented, and relational database management systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT Codex and Claude Cowork.

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.

+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.

* **Program Governance & Delivery Excellence**

+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* **AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering:** Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* **Automation & Deployment Engineering:** Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* **MLOps / LLMOps:** Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* **Data Engineering & Operationalization:** Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* **Programming & APIs:** Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.

Hands-on experience in building production-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage
