54cb6b65.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
54cb6b65.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

2b4d61b4.title: Security Architect
2b4d61b4.description:
**Education Qualification:**

  

* **Required:** Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent.
* **Preferred:** Masters degree in Computer Science or specialized Cybersecurity.

**Architectural Credentials:** Formal training or certifications in enterprise security architecture frameworks (e.g., **SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP-ISSAP, or CCSP**).

  

**Keyskills and Experience:**

* **Architectural Blueprinting:** Master-level capability in designing and maintaining secure reference architectures, security design patterns, and enterprise-wide zoning models.
* **Strategic Security Direction:** Proven experience translating high-level business goals and risk tolerances into technical security strategies and engineering roadmaps.
* **Cross-Domain Governance:** Strong architectural oversight across modern infrastructure paradigms, including hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure), edge retail networks, and multi-tenant digital ecosystems.
* **Threat Modelling Mastery:** Expert knowledge of structural threat modelling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE) to review and approve complex designs before deployment.
* **Regulatory & Framework Mapping:** Ability to align technical architecture with international and domestic frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and privacy regulations like **Indias DPDP Act**.

**High-Level Stakeholder Influence:** Exceptional articulation skills to advise, guide, and defend security architectural decisions to both engineering leads and business executives.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1. System Configuration and Maintenance**

* Define, maintain, and govern enterprise-wide secure configuration baselines, hardening standards, and "golden image" architecture blueprints for all infrastructure assets.
* Provide strategic direction for centralized configuration management frameworks to ensure automated, drift-free baseline enforcement across the digital footprint.

**2. Vulnerability Management**

* Architect the overarching framework and structural strategy for corporate vulnerability management, defining prioritization logic, systemic risk tolerances, and remediation SLAs.
* Review systemic vulnerability trends to identify structural design flaws in the network or infrastructure, and engineer permanent, architectural workarounds.

**3. Application Security**

* Establish reference architectures, secure design patterns, and cryptographic standards to guide engineering and DevOps teams toward building resilient software.
* Govern the structural integration requirements for security gates within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring architectural compliance is built-in by design.

**4. Data Security**

* Design and maintain the enterprise data protection architecture, including encryption-at-rest/in-transit standards, key management topologies, and tokenization frameworks.
* Provide architectural direction to align data storage, user access matrixes, and data flow pipelines with **India's DPDP Act 2023** and compliance requirements.

**5. Security Incident Management**

* Act as the ultimate architectural advisor during critical, high-severity security incidents to analyze root causes and diagnose systemic design vulnerabilities.
* Direct the post-incident architectural remediation strategies to permanently eliminate vector exposure and structurally immunize the organization against recurrence.

**6. Hardware and Software Upgrades**

* Author and maintain the security evaluation gate criteria for all corporate technology lifecycles, ensuring new hardware, software, or cloud platforms natively align with security architecture.
* Provide strategic technical direction for decommissioning legacy systems to prevent architectural debt and exposure.

**7. Security Governance and Strategy**

* Own, evolve, and maintain the mid-to-long-term Enterprise Security Architecture Strategy, ensuring seamless alignment with corporate risk profiles and business expansion goals.
* Act as the primary technical advisor to leadership, validating that all new digital initiatives conform to security-by-design and zero-trust principles.

**8. System Monitoring and Performance Optimization**

* Define the structural telemetry, logging, and visibility requirements across the enterprise to ensure the Security Operations Center (SOC) has optimized architectural coverage.
* Collaborate with infrastructure leads to ensure security controls are architected to scale dynamically without degrading core retail performance.

**9. Research and Continuous Improvement**

* Actively research next-generation security paradigms (e.g., Zero Trust Network Access, AI-driven defense, Decentralized Identity) to continually mature the enterprise security blueprint.
* Formulate proactive proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate and introduce modern, resilient security technologies into the technology ecosystem.

**10. Technical Support and Guidance**

* Provide high-level architectural mentorship, advisory, and technical direction to engineering, DevOps, cloud, and traditional IT operational teams.
* Serve as the final authority and arbitrator for all technical security design disputes or risk-exception requests across the organization.

**11. Documentation and Compliance**

* Author, maintain, and publish the official Enterprise Security Architecture Documentation, reference patterns, and structural policies.

Audit and ensure that current operational workflows and technical configurations map precisely back to approved architectural standards and corporate compliance mandates.

163eb358.title: Senior Technical Consultant -Migration-Revenue Cloud/Marketing Cloud
163eb358.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant — Agentforce Revenue Cloud Management is a hands-on delivery specialist responsible for executing the CPQ configuration, billing setup, data migration and Agentforce agent implementation workstreams within Revenue Cloud migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns specific delivery workstreams end-to-end — including Salesforce CPQ product catalogue configuration, pricing rule builds, contract and subscription data migration, billing schedule setup, ERP integration development and Agentforce revenue agent configuration. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants and ensures factory quality standards are met across all Revenue Cloud deliverables.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute Salesforce CPQ configuration — building product catalogue structures, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, price books, guided selling configurations, approval process setups, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic as specified in the Technical Architect's CPQ solution design.
* Execute product catalogue and pricing data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle for CPQ objects: loading products, price book entries, pricing tiers, bundle configurations and discount structures using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines — validating record counts and pricing logic post-load.
* Migrate active contracts and subscription records — transforming legacy contract records to Salesforce object schema, loading Contract, Subscription, Asset and Order objects, preserving relationship integrity and validating amendment/renewal eligibility post-migration.
* Configure Salesforce Billing — setting up billing schedules, invoice templates, payment terms, usage-based billing configurations, tax engine integration settings and dunning workflow automation as directed by the TA.
* Develop Apex components for Revenue Cloud migration — writing Batch Apex for bulk CPQ/Billing data migration, SBQQ plugin override classes, custom price calculation triggers, quote calculation hooks and REST callout adapters for ERP integration.
* Implement Agentforce revenue agents — configuring Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard and custom Apex actions for revenue use cases (quote-assist, renewal agents, deal desk agents) as specified in the Solution Architect's agent blueprint.
* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing LWC dashboards, Salesforce Flow orchestrations and Apex batch utilities for CPQ quote validation, contract record reconciliation and billing schedule verification.
* Develop ERP integration components — building REST/SOAP callout adapters and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing-to-ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) data flows as directed by the Technical Architect.
* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating CPQ and billing data migration dry runs: loading data into SIT/UAT environments, validating pricing rule outputs, confirming billing schedule generation and iterating to dry run sign-off.
* Support go-live cutover execution — executing final CPQ/Billing data loads, validating product catalogue integrity, confirming active contract migration completeness and activating Agentforce agents.
* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing CPQ configuration workbooks, pricing rule documentation, contract migration mapping sheets and Agentforce agent configuration guides for client team handover.
* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC CPQ configuration and data migration work, explaining Revenue Cloud platform patterns and unblocking technical issues aligned to factory standards.
* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating CPQ config templates, pricing rule patterns, contract migration scripts, Agentforce prompt and action libraries and billing validation tools.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ) — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Salesforce CPQ end-to-end — products, price books, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, bundle configuration, guided selling, approval workflows, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic.
* Salesforce Billing Configuration: Hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Billing — billing schedules, invoice generation, usage-based billing, payment terms, tax engine integration and dunning workflows.
* CPQ & Billing Data Migration Execution: Demonstrated experience loading high-volume CPQ and Billing objects — Products, PricebookEntries, Contracts, Subscriptions, Assets, Orders — using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines.
* Agentforce Configuration: Working knowledge of Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard actions and custom Apex actions — sufficient to implement revenue agent blueprints defined by the Solution Architect.
* Apex & Platform Development: Solid Apex development skills — Batch Apex for CPQ/Billing data migration, Schedulable classes, SBQQ plugin overrides, Apex trigger frameworks, REST callout adapters for ERP integration and Apex test classes.
* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, CPQ validation UIs and Salesforce Flow orchestrations as internal factory tooling.
* ERP Integration Development: Experience developing REST/SOAP callout handlers and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing-to-ERP (SAP, Oracle or NetSuite) integration.
* ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory) for extracting and transforming legacy CPQ, contract and billing data.
* Data Architecture — CPQ Objects: Understanding of Salesforce CPQ data model — Quote, Quote Line, Product, Price Book, Contract, Subscription, Asset, Order and Billing object relationships.
* CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable in Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows — committing Apex code and CPQ metadata, following branching conventions and using Gearset/Copado.

**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**

* Experience migrating from Apttus/Conga CPQ, Zuora, Oracle CPQ or Salesforce Classic CPQ (Big Machines) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud
* Knowledge of Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) — dynamic revenue contracts and flexible pricing model configuration
* of Salesforce Subscription Management for direct-to-consumer billing model configuration
* Experience with multi-currency CPQ configuration and multi-entity billing setups for global enterprise clients
* Knowledge of payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Zuora) at the implementation level

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–8 years of Salesforce platform delivery experience with a focus on CPQ, billing and revenue operations
* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ configuration experience across at least 2 CPQ implementations or migrations
* Demonstrated experience executing CPQ and contract data migrations — loading Products, Contracts, Subscriptions and Assets with relationship integrity at scale
* Hands-on Apex development experience — particularly Batch Apex for data migration, SBQQ plugin overrides and REST callout adapters
* Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on CPQ configuration and data migration tasks

SALESFORCE & PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS
  
  

* Required: Salesforce CPQ Specialist
* Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I
* Required: Salesforce Administrator
* Preferred: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Consultant
* Preferred: Salesforce Billing Specialist
* Preferred: Agentforce Specialist
* Preferred: Salesforce Certified Data ArchitectFamiliarity with Salesforce Industries (Vlocity/OmniStudio) — DataRaptors and Integration Procedures for telco/media CPQ automation
* Understanding

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can

. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

4690ef5d.title: Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Platforms
4690ef5d.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement Cloud Resources: Oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure High Availability: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Right-size resources, develop cost-effective solutions, and monitor usage patterns to optimize cloud costs.
* Automate Processes: Use automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Services Proficiency: Experience with cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, along with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* DevOps Practices: Experience with DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and applying these practices to cloud infrastructure management.
* Automation Tools: Experience using automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, and ability to manage and execute cloud migration plans.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud Security Best Practices: Experience with implementing and enforcing cloud security measures to ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations, including data encryption, access controls, and threat detection.
* Advanced Cloud Automation: Experience with advanced automation tools and scripting languages, such as Python or PowerShell, to automate complex cloud infrastructure tasks and workflows.
* Multi-Cloud Expertise: Experience managing and integrating multiple cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and others, to provide a seamless and efficient cloud infrastructure.

6eeb85f3.title: Solutions Architect – Cloud & AI Security
6eeb85f3.description:
**About searce**

Searce is an AI outcome engineering company and a modern technology consultancy that helps enterprises futurify their business with AI, cloud and data. Founded in 2004, we are 1,300+ Searcians across 12 countries, with deep business process expertise, a Google Cloud Global MSP status and compliance credentials including PCI DSS and ISO 27001. We solve with our proprietary evlos™ problem-solving methodology: no bureaucratic fluff, working prototypes fast, and production scale that holds.

**About ATRE**

ATRE is Searce's AI Trust & Resilience Engineering practice: the managed-service team that keeps customers' cloud and AI estates secure, reliable and resilient 24x7. We are building it AI-first. Every engineer is expected to use AI tools and AIOps to raise efficiency, cut toil and shorten recovery time.

**Role overview**

As a Solutions Architect you design how Searce delivers secure, resilient and AI-enabled operations for customers. You stay hands-on in delivery, set the technical direction for the ATRE team, and from time to time support presales with solutioning, customer workshops and proposals.

**what you'll do**

* **Architecture ownership:**
  Design secure, reliable multi-cloud and Kubernetes architectures, landing zones and DR patterns for managed-service customers.
* **Hands-on delivery:**
  Stay close to implementation, review designs and unblock the delivery team on hard problems.
* **AI and AIOps design:**
  Define how AI tools and AIOps platforms are used to improve SRE efficiency, covering triage, RCA, automation and observability.
* **Security by design:**
  Embed Zero Trust, IAM, secrets, network and compliance controls into customer solutions.
* **Presales support:**
  When required, join customer discussions, shape solutions and contribute to proposals and estimates.
* **Standards:**
  Create reference architectures, runbooks and best practices that the squads reuse.
* **Advisory:**
  Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal leaders.
* **Mentoring:**
  Raise the technical depth of engineers and leads.

**what you bring**

* **Delivery experience:**
  Hands-on experience delivering and operating cloud, SRE or security solutions in production, not only designing them.
* **Architecture depth:**
  Strong architecture skills across at least one hyperscaler, with Kubernetes, IaC and cloud security.
* **Communication:**
  Able to explain architecture to customer and executive audiences.
* **Presales exposure:**
  Experience supporting solutioning or proposals is valued; it is an occasional part of the role.
* **AI-led efficiency:**
  Practical experience using AI tools to improve SRE efficiency (AI-assisted runbooks, incident triage, RCA, automation) and/or AIOps platforms (e.g., BigPanda, Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Datadog), with measurable results such as lower MTTR, less toil or reduced alert noise.
* **Work mode:**
  Comfortable working from the office.

**Good to have**

* Professional-level architect certifications (Google, AWS, Azure)
* Experience across more than one hyperscaler
* Experience designing AI/LLM workload security and governance
* Compliance exposure (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2)

**Why searce**

* **Solver mindset:**
  We hire solvers, not task-takers. You will be trusted to own problems end to end.
* **Not a CAVEr, say no to HiPPO:**
  We are not Citizens Against Virtually Everything, and the best idea wins over the highest-paid person's opinion.
* **AI-native practice:**
  ATRE is built around AI tools and AIOps from day one, so you build the future of managed services rather than inherit the past.
* **Learning and growth:**
  Partner-led certifications and exposure to Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks and Anthropic Claude ecosystems.
* **Culture:**
  HAPPIER values (humble, adaptable, positive, passionate, innovative, excellence, responsible).

Interested candidates can apply here or share the resume directly to mohammed.rabi@searce.com

02c0ce78.title: Director, Solution Architecture - Consulting
02c0ce78.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.

Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

Architecture Design and Deployment

Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.

Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end-to-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.

Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.

Practice Development

Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Anticipates and addresses organization- and industry-wide gaps, patterns, and needs to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Leads and contributes to internal/external communities.

Trusted Advisor

Develops a deep network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers at high-impact customers/partners to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. Provides guidance to others in doing so. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.

Coaches team to use evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Leverages network and industry experience to connect customers/partners with ideas, people, and resources to support their success. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.

Drives awareness across all levels of the organization of partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy. Holds team accountable for leading the adoption of Microsoft technologies.

Thought Leadership

Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team at the corporate level. Holds teams across all organizational levels accountable for sharing insights with virtual team members, including C-level leaders, to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.

Initiates and drives external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons). Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Serves as an industry-leading expert and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences and publishing white papers around key technical topics and/or architecture design templates.

Other

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security))

OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 10+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR equivalent experience.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 15+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR equivalent experience.

8+ years technical sales experience.

8+ years project management experience.

4+ years managing multiple, complex projects or portfolios.

2+ years experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.

5+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.

Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

a7a8c003.title: Technical Architect
a7a8c003.description:
**Power Platform Solutions Architect**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Role**

Power Platform Solutions Architect

  

**Experience**

15+ years overall; 6+ years in Microsoft Power Platform and cloud solutions

**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking an experienced Power Platform Solutions Architect to lead the design, architecture, governance, and implementation of enterprise-scale solutions using Microsoft Power Platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Microsoft Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Azure services, and integration architecture. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, delivery teams, and enterprise architects to design scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-performing solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Solution Architecture and Design**
------------------------------------

* Define end-to-end solution architecture using Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Microsoft Dataverse, and Copilot Studio.
* Establish architecture standards, design patterns, reusable components, and technical guardrails.
* Create conceptual, logical, integration, security, and deployment architecture artifacts.

**Dataverse and Data Modeling**
-------------------------------

* Design enterprise-grade Dataverse data models, tables, columns, lookup relationships, and business rules.
* Define strategies that minimize data duplication and support data consistency across applications.
* Design Dataverse security roles, field-level security, ownership models, and auditing approaches.
* Plan data migration, archival, retention, and performance optimization strategies.

**Integration Architecture**
----------------------------

* Design integrations between Power Platform and Azure services, REST APIs, SQL Server, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and legacy enterprise applications.
* Define integration patterns for synchronous and asynchronous processing, error handling, monitoring, and resiliency.
* Design secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID and supported identity providers.
* Evaluate when to use standard connectors, custom connectors, APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management.

**Governance and Application Lifecycle Management**
---------------------------------------------------

* Define environment strategy across Development, SIT, UAT, Training, and Production.
* Lead solution packaging, source control, managed solution deployment, and CI/CD implementation using Azure DevOps and Git.
* Define data loss prevention policies, connector governance, monitoring, support, and operational standards.

**Security and Compliance**
---------------------------

* Design role-based access, least-privilege controls, data protection, and secure external access patterns.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Define logging, monitoring, auditing, vulnerability remediation, and production support requirements.

**AI and Copilot Solutions**
----------------------------

* Architect intelligent business solutions using Copilot Studio, AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, and relevant Power Platform AI capabilities.
* Design responsible AI controls, human oversight, data grounding, security, and monitoring for AI-enabled solutions.
* Identify practical automation and conversational AI opportunities aligned with business outcomes.

**Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Management**
---------------------------------------------------

* Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture workshops, design reviews, and technical governance forums.
* Translate business and non-functional requirements into architecture decisions and implementation roadmaps.
* Provide technical direction, mentoring, and design guidance to developers and delivery teams.
* Support effort estimation, risk assessment, dependency management, quality assurance, releases, and production stabilization.
* Prepare architecture documents, technical design specifications, deployment guides, and knowledge-transfer materials.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
======================================

**Microsoft Power Platform**
----------------------------

* Power Apps: Canvas apps and model-driven apps
* Power Automate: cloud flows, approvals, error handling, and monitoring
* Power Pages: portal architecture, security, authentication, Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap
* Microsoft Dataverse: data modeling, relationships, security, business rules, auditing, and performance
* Copilot Studio and AI Builder
* Solutions, environment variables, connection references, managed solutions, and deployment pipelines

**Microsoft Cloud and Integration**
-----------------------------------

* Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID
* REST APIs, web services, custom connectors, SQL Server, SharePoint, and Dynamics 365 integration
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, integration patterns, and error handling

**Development and DevOps**
--------------------------

Previous experience of handling large scale enterprise application developed in Java/C#, .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Power Fx, and REST

* Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated deployments, and environment management
* Experience with custom connectors, plugins, PCF controls, or Azure extensions is desirable

**Architecture and Delivery**
-----------------------------

* Enterprise and solution architecture, data modeling, integration architecture, security architecture, and performance optimization
* Experience leading architecture for complex, multi-application enterprise programs
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, documentation, presentation, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to balance out-of-the-box capabilities, configuration, low-code development, and custom development

**Preferred Certifications**
============================

0b3b4f57.description:
**Human Capital- Senior Manager**

  
  

The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Centered on five core issues, this Portfolio signifies to the market that we see Human Capital as a topic critical to the C-Suite. As we go-to-market we will show our clients that we serve more than HR organizations – from the CEO to CFO, Risk Manager to Business Unit leader—and that we deliver on our issues and help create value for our clients.

  
  

Looking for a world of opportunities and a fulfilling career?

  
  

**Work you’ll do**

  
  

Responsible for managing end to end delivery and management of multiple global SAP HCM / Success Factors AMS projects. This role involves in-depth understanding of processes across various HCM and SF modules and the ability to define various strategies and leading teams.

  
  

* Play lead roles preferably on multiple projects. Understands project statuses, understands project lifecycle, manage mitigation of risks and issues, set up change control processes and escalation points, manage the service transitions

* Responsible for adhering to the current project management methodology while influencing best practices, process improvements, and procedures

* Experience and ability to work in an onsite/offshore model supporting US and global clients

* Deliver HR solutions to clients leveraging past domain experience and Deloitte tools and methodologies

* Support pre-sales and sales activities working with US and India based leaders

* Provide quality assurance of deliverables across multiple projects

* Support the growth of talent within the practice through recruitment, mentorship and coaching

* Participate in practice development and knowledge transfer activities

* Manage operational activities for the practice in India

* Ownership of operational activities related to staffing, recruiting and training

* Establish open, fluid, and timely communications with all interested parties, stakeholders, and project teams

* Ensure client satisfaction targets are achieved

* Ensure business and assignment risks are identified, monitored and managed to achieve minimal disruption to the project delivery and success

* Act as a HCM / Successfactors subject matter expert by providing best-practice guidance on business processes

  

**The Team**

  
  

**Insights, Innovation & Operate** Offering helps Clients sustain organizational performance and enable ongoing insights into the organization with a comprehensive set of services and solutions that extend the capabilities of the organization with products, solutions and operate capabilities provided as a service.

Our US India regions are a part of our US firm, which enable our consultants to drive world-class client service. They are hence referred to as US India. HC Operate is a rapidly growing service offering and we are looking for talented colleagues to join our practice. Our practice is the leading group for cloud technology work and our consultants are world class driving technical and functional solutions for our clients both in US and globally.

  
  

The **Operate** offering focuses on providing Application Management Services, which include Workday, Oracle Cloud, SuccessFactors, Workforce Software, Kronos, ConnectMe and LaborWise.

  
  

As a Senior Manager, you will be responsible for managing a part of the business, growing our business, leading sales pursuits, managing and delivering on multiple projects and performance management of people in your teams. This is a leadership role with our practice.

  
  

**Qualifications**

  
  

* Required B.Tech/B.E/MBA/MCA

* 15+ years of experience in SAP HCM /SAP SuccessFactors

* Consulting and project management experience in delivering and Operate engagements on SaaS applications in HCM Space (Cloud experience is a must)

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* This position would require at least 50% of the time to be spent on client service while, the remaining time would be spent towards practice building, staffing and recruiting

* Client service is a key component of this role and the person will be expected to provide leadership to teams based in India

* Extensive experience working on HR projects as a leader, team management, subject matter expertise and an expert in Technology

* Experience leading large, multi-region, Operate engagements with overall team size of more than 80 team members/consultants

* Experience in HR processes and having worked on multiple projects in the HR process domain

* Understands HCM maintenance strategies across work, understands review processes and sets standards and checkpoints to ensure quality deliverables, understands how HR application interfaces with other modules / third party applications and respective dependencies

* Should have experience in leading multiple large disparate teams in a global delivery model

* Ability to leverage HR domain subject matter expertise to provide hands on guidance on projects, sales pursuits etc.

* Ability to support the growth of talent within the practice through recruitment, mentorship, and coaching

* Should have high energy level and passion for technology

* Ability to clearly demonstrate the advantages of a proposed approach or solution.

  
  

**#CA-GS**

  

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

5cf472ee.title: Program Manager
5cf472ee.description:
**Compensation:**

Annual Salary: ₹2,913,665

Join our innovative, global team using technology to transform the way the social sector engages with data. We run on passion, blending diverse skill sets and experiences with a collective mission to help social impact organizations tackle challenges and achieve greater impact globally. We’re a self-motivated, creative group that encourages all staff to push their own boundaries and drive the company in exciting new directions. As a social enterprise and certified B Corporation, we reinvest a majority of our profits in our growth and continued pursuit of our mission and vision.

**Position Overview**

As a Program Manager at Vera, you are responsible for ensuring that complex initiatives move from planning to delivery smoothly, predictably, and at a high standard of quality.

You sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Client Success, and business teams, bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to the work. As Vera increasingly adopts AI-assisted development practices, you will also help teams operate effectively in an AI-enabled delivery environment.

Success in this role means delivering outcomes on time, proactively managing risks, keeping stakeholders aligned, and continuously improving how teams work together.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Program Delivery & Execution**

* Own the successful delivery of multiple initiatives across product development, client engagements, AI offerings, and internal projects.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
* Identify risks early, remove blockers, and drive resolution before they impact delivery.
* Lead release planning, execution tracking, and post-release reviews.
* Partner with teams to ensure commitments are realistic, achievable, and transparent.

**Process Excellence & AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Help define and continuously improve delivery workflows across Product, Engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Support the adoption of AI-assisted development practices and ensure teams have the right processes, context, and documentation to work effectively.
* Establish clear quality gates, definitions of done, and operational metrics.
* Drive retrospectives and process improvements that improve quality, predictability, and team effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Serve as the primary coordination point across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Provide clear, concise program updates, status reports, risk assessments, and delivery forecasts.
* Facilitate decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information they need at the right time.
* Manage delivery-related communications, including timeline changes, escalations, and release updates.

**Planning, Capacity & Operational Management**

* Partner with functional leads to manage team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery planning.
* Support estimation, prioritization, and scheduling activities across multiple workstreams.
* Monitor program health through delivery metrics, capacity data, and operational reporting.
* Ensure work is tracked accurately and delivery commitments remain aligned with available capacity.

**Risk Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain visibility into delivery, quality, operational, and organizational risks.
* Develop mitigation plans and contingency strategies for critical initiatives.
* Lead incident coordination and lessons-learned exercises when required.
* Champion a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

**Team Enablement & Program Leadership**

* Coach and support Program Associates and junior team members.
* Promote strong project management practices, documentation standards, and delivery discipline.
* Contribute to organization-wide initiatives related to delivery excellence, AI adoption, and operational maturity.
* Act as a trusted partner and facilitator across teams, helping individuals and groups perform at their best.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 7+ years of Program or Project Management experience in software delivery environments
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and software development lifecycles
* Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and business teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong planning, prioritization, risk management, and problem-solving abilities
* Expertise with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and project planning/reporting platforms

**Desired**

* Experience working with AI-assisted development tools and workflows
* Familiarity with agentic development environments, AI governance, or AI-enabled delivery practices
* PMP, PSM, CSM, or similar project/program management certification
* Exposure to SaaS product development, professional services delivery, or consulting environments
* Basic technical understanding of software architecture, APIs, Git workflows, and CI/CD practices

162b038e.title: Engagement Manager
162b038e.description:
Trinity Life Sciences is seeking an Engagement Manager to join our rapidly growing Competitive Intelligence (CI) team.
  
  
We work at the forefront of life sciences strategy, partnering with leading biopharma clients to translate complex competitive landscapes into clear, decision-driving insights. As part of a high-impact team within our Commercial Strategy group, you will lead client engagements spanning real-time monitoring, deep-dive analyses, and executive-level workshops that shape critical decisions across drug development and commercialization.
  
  
With strong mentorship, visible leadership opportunities, and a collaborative, expert-driven culture, Trinity CI offers a unique platform to accelerate your career while making a meaningful impact on therapies that improve patients’ lives.
  
  
**Do You Have Experience In And a Passion For**

* Supporting clients who deliver life-changing and life-saving therapies?
* Delivering high-quality, impactful client work?
* Leading and managing strategic projects?
* Developing clear, actionable insights and implications?
* Coaching and developing teams?

If so, Trinity could be the right place to grow your career and influence decisions that truly matter.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
Project Management
  
  

* Lead and manage all phases of competitive intelligence projects, including initial setup, data gathering, analysis, and strategic synthesis
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects, building strong and enduring relationships based on trust
* Lead the design and facilitation of client workshops when included in project deliverables
* Collaborate with team members to deliver projects on scope and in a way that exceeds client expectations
* Organize work and manage timelines across assigned clients, projects, and deliverables
* Monitor project budgets against revenue targets and support achievement of Competitive Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE) goals
* Partner with CI and cross-functional leadership to align work streams and ensure continuity between CI offerings and other Trinity engagements

Insight Generation
  
  

* Drive analysis and storyline development, articulating the “so what” for clients
* Present competitive intelligence findings to clients compellingly, facilitating discussion on how to best position their products for success
* Cover key medical and industry conferences, attending priority sessions and conducting high-quality human-source research in line with legal, compliance, and SCIP ethical standards

People Management
  
  

* Train and manage junior staff across projects, including CI team members and cross-functional staff supporting CI
* Serve as a subject matter expert on CI methodology and best practices, upskilling team members across Trinity

Business Development
  
  

* Collaborate with Commercial Strategy client teams to identify opportunities and manage follow-ups
* Identify expansion opportunities with existing clients
* Support proposal development and competitive intelligence program design

Position Requirements
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree preferred.
  
  
**Work Experience: 5+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, consulting, or related roles within the life sciences industry.**
**Skills And Attributes**

* Proven ability to lead and develop junior staff and communicate confidently with senior client and internal stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently with accuracy and attention to detail
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, drug development, and global healthcare systems
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, including data visualization and slide development; familiarity with CI sources and relational databases is a plus
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic synthesis skills, with solid business acumen
* A curious, entrepreneurial mindset—always asking what’s next and challenging assumptions about the competitive landscape

-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage large technical projects from concept to launch, develop and coordinate realistic project estimates, plans, or metrics; work and communicate effectively with engineering, product management, QA, operations and other stakeholders.
* Understand Google Geo products, internal tools, processes and data schema and leverage those to push automation and increase work efficiency and automation.
* Develop technical solutions that help automate and improve operational efficiencies.
* Leverage technical acumen and developer skills to analyze trends in date, develop data pipeline improvements and elegant technical solutions.
* Build scalable and intelligent technical and operational solutions to produce large volumes of high quality data that powers Google Maps.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

1a934b4d.title: Program Manager I, ATS Programs
1a934b4d.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we are always exploring new opportunities to shape our global business. As a Program Manager I, you will play a key role in executing and improving programs that drive operational excellence. You will support the design and rollout of new initiatives, while owning the day-to-day management of existing programs. This role is designed for individuals who thrive in structured environments and are building strong program management fundamentals.  
This is your opportunity to have a meaningful impact on some of the most exciting initiatives that are shaping the future of Amazon.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Execute defined programs and support launches within a structured scope  
Track performance metrics and provide updates on program deliverables  
Use data to identify operational gaps and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions and best practices  
Coordinate tasks, manage dependencies, and escalate risks when needed  
Support process standardization and documentation to improve scalability and consistency  
  
A day in the life  
As a Program Manager I, your day will focus on execution and coordination. You will manage defined projects, track progress against goals, and ensure timely delivery of tasks.  
  
You’ll work closely with stakeholders across teams to understand requirements, resolve blockers, and maintain visibility on program health. While you may seek guidance for complex decisions, you are expected to independently manage day-to-day execution.  
  
You’ll also use data to identify trends, support improvements to existing processes, and ensure that deliverables align with team goals and metrics. Your work will contribute directly to the reliability and efficiency of operations.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) plays a central role in ensuring efficient and reliable delivery across the network. As part of ATS, you’ll work with a diverse team focused on optimizing transportation across air, sea, and road networks using advanced technology and data-driven decision-making.  
  
The team prioritizes safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. By leveraging data and collaboration, ATS ensures packages are delivered quickly, efficiently, and sustainably while maintaining high standards of reliability.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* 1+ years of working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience coordinating program execution and tracking performance

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Experience with SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience in resolving conflicts, providing crisis management triage, and setting appropriate expectations with customers
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

4783300d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Multimedia Team

41e1d996.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41e1d996.description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Kaseya is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-platform technical programs that span multiple SaaS products, engineering organizations, and business functions. In this role, you will operate as a force multiplier for engineering and product leadership, driving execution rigor, dependency management, and delivery predictability across complex initiatives such as platform integrations, modernization efforts, reliability improvements, and enterprise-scale launches. This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Program Leadership & Delivery
  
  

* Own and drive end-to-end execution of large, cross-functional technical programs impacting multiple Kaseya products and platforms
* Translate company-level priorities into clear program plans, milestones, success metrics, and delivery commitments
* Actively manage scope, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, security, and reliability standards appropriate for MSP and enterprise customers

Technical & Architectural Partnership
  
  

* Partner closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand system design, platform constraints, and technical risks
* Drive alignment on architecture decisions, sequencing, and integration strategies, especially across acquired products
* Develop technical fluency across Kaseya's SaaS platforms, APIs, data flows, and cloud infrastructure

Stakeholder & Executive Communication
  
  

* Serve as the single-threaded owner for program health, communicating clearly with senior engineering, product, and executive leaders
* Produce crisp executive-level updates that highlight progress, risks, mitigation plans, and decision points
* Facilitate decision-making across organizations with competing priorities and limited resources

Operational Excellence & Scale
  
  

* Establish scalable program management frameworks, operating rhythms, and tooling to support Kaseya's growth
* Identify systemic execution gaps and drive improvements in planning, dependency management, and delivery predictability
* Mentor and influence other TPMs, helping raise the bar for technical program management across the organization

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles in SaaS or cloud-based software environments
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage deeply in architecture, APIs, data, and cloud-native systems
* Proven experience leading multi-team, multi-product programs with significant technical and organizational complexity
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in a fast-paced, matrixed organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on platform integration, M&A integration, or large-scale SaaS modernization initiatives
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), distributed systems, and enterprise-grade security requirements
* Experience supporting B2B, IT management, security, or MSP-focused products
* Strong working knowledge of Agile and hybrid delivery models
* Prior experience mentoring TPMs or acting as a program leader across multiple initiatives

**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*
